generic.Defined scope/population: Every beneficiary designation change recorded on the policy in the 24 months before the insured's date of death.
generic.In-scope period: The 24 months preceding date of death, with a 90-day near-death sub-window flagged separately.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each change carries effective date, requesting party, new payee relationship code and signature source.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Change count on the extract equals the change count on the PolicyCenter designation history screen.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Change-history extract attached to the ClaimCenter file with system run date and extracting user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every tripped near-death flag carries an SIU referral number or a documented no-referral rationale.
generic.Test population: All death claims where a beneficiary change exists within 24 months of date of death.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of near-death flagged claims have an SIU referral raised within 48 hours of the flag.
generic.Exception handling path: Flags the examiner cannot clear go to the SIU Investigator with the change history attached.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Change history dated relative to date of death and every flag dispositioned before adjudication.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim file fraud section plus the FRISS referral record for the claim.

steps.title: Extract beneficiary change history from PolicyCenter
sop: Open the policy in PolicyCenter and select the beneficiary designation history view.
Set the date range to the 24 months ending on the insured's date of death.
Export every change with effective date, requester, new payee and relationship code.
Done when the 24-month change-history extract is attached to the ClaimCenter claim file.
verify: Compare the exported change count to the count shown on the PolicyCenter history screen.
Pass when the extract is on the claim and the two change counts agree exactly.

steps.title: Date each change against date of death in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the elapsed days between each change effective date and the date of death.
Set the near-death flag on any change made within 90 days of death.
Set the same flag where the change followed a documented terminal diagnosis.
Done when every change on the extract carries a days-to-death value and a flag state.
verify: Recompute the day count for the most recent change from the certified death certificate.
Pass when every change row has a days-to-death value and the flag matches the 90-day rule.

steps.title: Compare change-request signatures in the document repository
sop: Retrieve the imaged change request and the original application signature page.
Compare the insured signature on the change to the application signature.
Note any signature applied by a power of attorney rather than the insured.
Done when a signature comparison note is recorded for each flagged change.
verify: Confirm both source images are legible and carry the insured's name.
Pass when each flagged change has a recorded signature match or mismatch conclusion.

steps.title: Assess added-payee relationship in PolicyCenter
sop: Read the relationship code recorded for each newly added beneficiary.
Mark non-family payees, caregivers and newly appointed attorneys-in-fact as elevated risk.
Record the relationship and risk note against the change row on the claim.
Done when every added payee on a flagged change has a relationship risk note.
verify: Check the relationship code against the supporting change form wording.
Pass when each added payee carries a relationship code and a risk classification.

steps.title: Raise the SIU referral in ClaimCenter and FRISS
sop: Create the SIU referral on the claim within 48 hours of the first tripped flag.
Attach the change-history extract, signature note and relationship assessment.
Record the FRISS score and any matching fraud indicators on the referral.
Done when the referral carries a case number and the payment hold is applied.
verify: Compare the referral creation timestamp to the flag-set timestamp.
Pass when every flagged claim has a referral raised inside 48 hours with the extract attached.

steps.title: Record the timing conclusion on the ClaimCenter claim
sop: Write the conclusion stating whether any change occurred suspiciously near death.
Cite the change dates, the signature finding and the referral number relied upon.
Release the fraud hold only where no flag remains open.
Done when the timing conclusion is saved and the claim fraud status is set.
verify: Read back the conclusion against the change-history extract on file.
Pass when the conclusion cites specific change dates and no flag is left undispositioned.

generic.Defined scope/population: All newly notified death claims sitting in the unassigned queue awaiting a named handler.
generic.In-scope period: From the logged notification date until handler assignment, targeted within 24 hours.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Complexity score, handler name, authority level and assignment date populated on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims leaving the unassigned queue equal claims showing a named handler for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment event stamped in ClaimCenter with assigning user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims exceeding the handler's authority are logged and routed to dual handling.
generic.Test population: Every death claim notified in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of claims have a named handler within 24 hours of notification.
generic.Exception handling path: Contestable or interpleader-risk claims escalate to a senior Life Claims Examiner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Handler field populated, queue released and diary started on the assignment date.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter assignment history and the workflow tool work-list entry.

steps.title: Score claim complexity in ClaimCenter
sop: Read face amount, issue date, claimant count and residency from the linked policy record.
Apply the complexity matrix to produce a standard, complex or senior routing band.
Record the band and the drivers that set it on the claim.
Done when a complexity band is stored on the claim record.
verify: Recompute the band from the face amount and contestable indicator.
Pass when the stored band matches the matrix output for those inputs.

steps.title: Route contestable and interpleader-risk claims to a senior examiner
sop: Check the contestable flag and any competing-claimant indicator on the claim.
Where either is set, select the senior Life Claims Examiner pool rather than the standard pool.
Record the routing reason on the assignment note.
Done when every flagged claim shows senior-pool routing with a reason.
verify: List flagged claims assigned in the period and read their target pool.
Pass when no contestable or interpleader-risk claim sits in the standard pool.

steps.title: Set the handler field and release the queue in ClaimCenter
sop: Select the named handler from the routed pool using current workload.
Populate the handler field on the claim record.
Release the claim from the unassigned work queue.
Done when the claim shows a named handler and no longer appears unassigned.
verify: Refresh the unassigned queue and search for the claim number.
Pass when the claim has a named handler and is absent from the unassigned queue.

steps.title: Check handler settlement authority against expected face amount
sop: Read the expected face amount plus estimated interest from the linked policy.
Compare it to the assigned handler's delegated settlement authority limit.
Where the amount exceeds the limit, flag the claim for dual handling or reassignment.
Done when the authority comparison is recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the recorded authority level against the handler's entry in the approval matrix.
Pass when the recorded authority covers the expected payable or a dual-handling flag is set.

steps.title: Send the assignment notification from the workflow tool
sop: Trigger the assignment notification to the named handler.
Confirm the claim appears on the handler's work list in the workflow tool.
Confirm the handler diary starts on the assignment date.
Done when the notification is sent and the claim is on the handler work list.
verify: Open the handler work list and locate the claim.
Pass when the claim is listed and the first diary date is populated.

steps.title: Log the assignment timing against the notification date
sop: Compare the assignment timestamp to the logged notification timestamp.
Record any assignment beyond 24 hours as an exception with a reason.
Report repeated breaches to claims management on the daily queue review.
Done when the elapsed assignment time is recorded on the claim.
verify: Run the daily unassigned-ageing report for the period.
Pass when every claim shows assignment inside 24 hours or a logged exception reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: The decedent named on the submitted death certificate matched against the insured on the policy master.
generic.In-scope period: From death certificate receipt until the identity match determination is recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Full legal name, date of birth, SSN last four and last address compared on both records.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every identity data point on the certificate has a matched or explained counterpart on the policy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Corroborating documents imaged to the claim file with received date and source.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each name or address variance carries a resolving document or an open mismatch flag.
generic.Test population: All death claims with a death certificate received in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim advances to adjudication with an unresolved identity mismatch flag.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved mismatches hold the claim and route to the Life Claims Examiner for a second source.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Match or no-match determination recorded with every corroborating document attached.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter identity section and the claim document repository folder.

steps.title: Compare core identity fields between the certificate and PolicyCenter
sop: Open the imaged death certificate and the policy master record side by side.
Compare full legal name, date of birth and the last four digits of the SSN.
Record each field as matched or variant on the claim identity panel.
Done when all three core fields carry a match or variant marker.
verify: Re-read the certificate image for the three fields captured.
Pass when every captured value matches the certificate image exactly.

steps.title: Resolve name variances with supporting documents
sop: Identify maiden, married, suffix or hyphenation differences between the records.
Request a marriage certificate, court order or deed poll evidencing the change.
Image the supporting document to the claim and link it to the variant field.
Done when every name variance has a linked resolving document.
verify: Open each variant field and follow the document link.
Pass when each name variance opens to a legible resolving document.

steps.title: Reconcile the decedent address to the last address of record
sop: Read the decedent residence address from the certificate.
Compare it to the last address of record in PolicyCenter.
Where they differ, locate the documented change of address transaction.
Done when the address is reconciled or the difference is explained on the claim.
verify: Read the address reconciliation note against the PolicyCenter address history.
Pass when the note points to a matching address or a dated change transaction.

steps.title: Corroborate identity with a second source where SSN is absent
sop: Confirm whether the certificate carries an SSN at all.
Where absent, obtain a second source such as the obituary plus agent confirmation.
Record what each source confirms and image both to the claim file.
Done when a second corroborating source is on file for every certificate lacking an SSN.
verify: List certificates on file without an SSN in the period.
Pass when each of those claims carries two independent corroborating sources.

steps.title: Record the match determination in ClaimCenter
sop: Select the identity outcome of matched, matched-with-variance or not matched.
Write the rationale naming the fields relied on and the documents used.
Attach every corroborating document to the identity requirement.
Done when the determination and rationale are saved on the claim.
verify: Read the saved determination against the field-level markers captured earlier.
Pass when the outcome is consistent with the field markers and documents attached.

steps.title: Hold adjudication while a mismatch flag remains open
sop: Set the identity mismatch flag where the outcome is not matched.
Apply the adjudication hold so the claim cannot advance while the flag is set.
Diary the flag for follow-up until a resolving document arrives.
Done when no unresolved mismatch claim can move to adjudication.
verify: Query claims in adjudication status carrying an open identity mismatch flag.
Pass when the query returns no claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every death claim requiring proof of death confirmed against the Death Master File.
generic.In-scope period: From claim opening to the point the date of death is confirmed for adjudication.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Insured SSN, full name and date of birth submitted to the search service.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Searches submitted equal search results filed against open death claims.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Timestamped LexisNexis Risk search output attached to the ClaimCenter claim file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Date variances between DMF and certificate logged with the amended-certificate request.
generic.Test population: All death claims opened in the period regardless of DMF hit or no hit.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every claim carries a DMF result with a run date before proceeds are released.
generic.Exception handling path: Date variance holds payment and routes to the Life Claims Examiner for an amended certificate.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim date of death equals the certified death certificate date with the DMF result on file.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter proof-of-death evidence section on the claim.

steps.title: Assemble the search identifiers from PolicyCenter
sop: Pull the insured SSN, full legal name and date of birth from the policy master.
Confirm the identifiers agree with the death certificate on file.
Note any identifier that is missing or unverified before searching.
Done when a complete identifier set is prepared for submission.
verify: Compare the prepared identifiers to the PolicyCenter insured record.
Pass when all three identifiers match the policy master values.

steps.title: Submit the search to LexisNexis Risk
sop: Submit the identifier set to the Death Master File and lost-policyholder search service.
Capture the search reference and the run date returned by the service.
Save the raw output rather than a retyped summary.
Done when the search output and run date are captured for the claim.
verify: Open the saved output and read the run date and search reference.
Pass when the output carries a run date and the submitted identifiers.

steps.title: Compare the returned date of death to the certificate
sop: Read the date of death returned by the service.
Compare it to the date on the certified death certificate and record the variance in days.
Record a zero variance explicitly where the dates agree.
Done when a variance in days is recorded on the claim.
verify: Recompute the variance from the two source dates.
Pass when the recorded variance equals the recomputed value.

steps.title: Record a negative DMF result where no hit is returned
sop: Where the service returns no match, record the negative result explicitly on the claim.
Note that the certified certificate stands as primary proof of death.
Attach the negative search output to the proof-of-death evidence section.
Done when the negative result is recorded and attached rather than left blank.
verify: List claims with no DMF hit in the period.
Pass when each carries an attached negative result rather than an empty field.

steps.title: Request an amended certificate where dates differ
sop: Where the variance is non-zero, hold the claim from proceeds release.
Issue a written request to the claimant for an amended certified certificate.
Diary the request and record the reason for the hold on the claim.
Done when the amended-certificate request is issued and the hold is set.
verify: Query claims with a recorded DMF date variance.
Pass when each shows a payment hold and an issued amended-certificate request.

steps.title: File the DMF evidence to the ClaimCenter claim
sop: Index the timestamped search output under the proof-of-death document type.
Confirm the claim date of death equals the certified certificate date.
Mark the proof-of-death requirement satisfied.
Done when the evidence is indexed and the requirement is marked satisfied.
verify: Open the proof-of-death section and read the indexed document and claim date.
Pass when the DMF output is present and the claim date matches the certificate.

generic.Defined scope/population: All life, annuity, group and rider coverages held on the deceased insured across administration systems.
generic.In-scope period: Coverage status assessed as at the date of death.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, product type, issue date, status and face or account value listed per hit.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Contracts found on the search equal claim records opened or documented as excluded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cross-book search result attached to the claim with the search run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lapsed or surrendered contracts excluded only with a documented pre-death termination date.
generic.Test population: All death claims where the insured is searched across life, annuity and group books.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No in-force contract on the insured is left without a claim record or a logged exclusion.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous annuity contracts route to the Annuity Service Specialist for the death-benefit workflow.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Search output listing every contract found is attached and each hit is dispositioned.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter coverage section with the PolicyCenter search extract attached.

steps.title: Run the cross-book search in PolicyCenter
sop: Search on insured SSN and date of birth across life, annuity and group administration.
Include closed and terminated statuses so exclusions can be evidenced.
Export the full result set with the search run date.
Done when the cross-book search output is attached to the claim.
verify: Re-run the search on SSN alone and compare the hit count.
Pass when the attached output covers every contract returned by both searches.

steps.title: List each hit with key contract attributes
sop: Record policy number, product type, issue date and status for each hit.
Record face amount for life contracts and account value for annuity contracts.
Load the list into the ClaimCenter coverage section.
Done when every hit carries the five attributes on the coverage list.
verify: Spot-check two entries against the PolicyCenter contract screens.
Pass when the listed attributes match the source records.

steps.title: Check for riders that pay on death
sop: Open each in-force contract and read the attached rider schedule.
Identify accidental death, child term, spouse term and return-of-premium riders.
Record each payable rider against its parent contract on the coverage list.
Done when every in-force contract shows its death-payable riders or none.
verify: Compare the rider list to the PolicyCenter rider schedule for one contract.
Pass when every in-force contract carries an explicit rider entry or a none marker.

steps.title: Flag annuity contracts for the annuity death-benefit workflow
sop: Identify contracts where the insured is the owner or the annuitant.
Record which role the insured held, since the payable benefit differs.
Flag each contract for the annuity death-benefit workflow in ClaimCenter.
Done when every annuity hit carries a role indicator and a workflow flag.
verify: List annuity hits and read their role indicator and workflow flag.
Pass when no annuity hit is left without a role indicator and flag.

steps.title: Document exclusions for lapsed and surrendered contracts
sop: For each excluded contract, read the lapse or surrender effective date.
Confirm the termination date precedes the date of death.
Record the exclusion reason and the termination date on the coverage list.
Done when every excluded contract carries a dated exclusion reason.
verify: Compare each exclusion date to the date of death.
Pass when no contract terminating after date of death is marked excluded.

steps.title: Open claim records for every applicable coverage
sop: Open a claim record in ClaimCenter for each in-force coverage identified.
Link related claims to the primary claim so the file is handled together.
Record the beneficiary contact against each claim in the CRM.
Done when every in-force coverage has a corresponding claim record.
verify: Compare the in-force list to the open claim records for the insured.
Pass when the counts agree with no in-force coverage left unclaimed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every known claimant on a newly opened death claim who must receive the acknowledgment packet.
generic.In-scope period: From the logged notification time until the packet is sent, targeted within 4 hours.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, examiner contact, statutory decision timeframe and requirements list present in the packet.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Packets sent equal known claimants on the claim record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgment letter imaged to the claim with template version, send date and channel.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claimants with no deliverable address logged and routed to location outreach.
generic.Test population: All claims with an acknowledgment due in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of claimants show a logged acknowledgment send date within 4 hours of notification.
generic.Exception handling path: Undeliverable packets are re-issued to a verified address and the exception is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: State-correct template used with all mandated enclosures and disclosures included.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter correspondence log and the claim document repository.

steps.title: Generate the state-correct acknowledgment letter in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the claimant's state of residence from the claimant record.
Select the approved acknowledgment template for that state.
Generate the letter and record the template version used.
Done when the letter is generated with the correct state template version recorded.
verify: Compare the template version on the letter to the approved template register.
Pass when the version matches the current approved template for that state.

steps.title: Assemble the required enclosures
sop: Enclose the claimant statement form and the W-9.
Enclose the product-specific requirements list produced for this claim.
Record the enclosure list against the claimant record.
Done when the enclosure list is complete and logged.
verify: Compare the logged enclosure list to the claim requirements list.
Pass when every mandatory enclosure for the product appears on the list.

steps.title: Populate claim, contact and statutory timeframe details
sop: Insert the claim number and the examiner's direct contact details.
State the statutory timeframe within which the company will make its decision.
Confirm the timeframe cited matches the governing state rule.
Done when claim number, contact and statutory timeframe all appear in the letter.
verify: Read the drafted letter for the three required data points.
Pass when all three appear and the timeframe matches the state rule table.

steps.title: Add settlement-option and retained asset account disclosures
sop: Include the settlement-option summary for the product and share size.
Include the retained asset account disclosure where an account is the default mode.
Confirm the disclosure wording is the current approved version.
Done when the disclosures required for this product are included.
verify: Check the packet against the disclosure matrix for the product and state.
Pass when every disclosure the matrix requires is present in the packet.

steps.title: Send separately to each claimant and log the send
sop: Address a separate packet to each known claimant on the claim.
Never enclose another claimant's documents in a packet.
Log the send date and channel against each claimant record in the CRM.
Done when every claimant has an individually addressed packet with a logged send.
verify: List claimants on the claim and read their send log entries.
Pass when every claimant has a send date and channel recorded.

steps.title: Image the sent packet to the claim document repository
sop: Image the exact letter and enclosure set that was sent.
Index it under the acknowledgment document type on the claim.
Confirm the imaged send date is within 4 hours of the logged notification.
Done when the imaged packet is on the claim with its send date.
verify: Compare the imaged send date to the notification timestamp.
Pass when the imaged packet is on file and dated within 4 hours of notification.

generic.Defined scope/population: The agent of record on the policy and, for group certificates, the employer group sponsor.
generic.In-scope period: From claim opening until both notifications are logged on the claim activity log.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recipient name, appointment status, notification date and channel recorded per notification.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notifications logged equal the agent and sponsor parties identified for the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Activity log entries carry recipient, date and channel with system timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unappointed or deceased agents logged with the redirect to agency or house account.
generic.Test population: All death claims opened in the period with an agent of record on the policy.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No agent notification contains beneficiary identity or benefit amount.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing sponsor contact routes to the Claims Analyst for group record retrieval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Agent-of-record and sponsor notification entries present with privacy-safe content.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim activity log and the CRM contact history.

steps.title: Look up the agent of record in PolicyCenter
sop: Open the policy master and read the agent of record and servicing agency.
Confirm the appointment is still active as at today.
Record the agent name, code and appointment status on the claim.
Done when the agent of record and appointment status are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded agent code to the PolicyCenter servicing record.
Pass when the code and appointment status match the policy master.

steps.title: Issue the privacy-safe agent notification from the CRM
sop: Notify the agent that a death claim has been opened on the policy.
Exclude beneficiary identity and benefit amount from the notification.
Record the notification text version sent to the agent.
Done when the agent notification is sent using the approved privacy-safe template.
verify: Read the sent notification for beneficiary names or amounts.
Pass when neither beneficiary identity nor benefit amount appears in the text.

steps.title: Notify the employer group sponsor for group certificates
sop: Determine whether the coverage is a group-issued certificate.
Notify the employer group sponsor and request the certificate and enrollment record.
Record the sponsor contact used and the documents requested.
Done when the sponsor notification and document request are sent and logged.
verify: List group claims in the period and read their sponsor notification entries.
Pass when every group claim carries a sponsor notification with a document request.

steps.title: Redirect notifications for unappointed or deceased agents
sop: Where the agent is unappointed or deceased, identify the servicing agency or house account.
Send the notification to that destination instead.
Record the redirect reason and the new recipient on the claim.
Done when every redirected notification carries a documented reason.
verify: List redirected notifications for the period.
Pass when each shows a reason and a valid alternate recipient.

steps.title: Log each notification on the ClaimCenter activity log
sop: Create an activity entry per notification with recipient, date and channel.
Attach the sent notification text or reference to the entry.
Confirm both agent and sponsor entries exist where both apply.
Done when every notification has a matching activity log entry.
verify: Count notifications sent against activity log entries for the claim.
Pass when the counts agree and each entry carries all three fields.

steps.title: Review the notification content for privacy compliance
sop: Sample the sent notifications for the claim and read their content.
Confirm no beneficiary identity or benefit amount was disclosed.
Raise a privacy incident where any disclosure is found.
Done when the privacy review outcome is recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the recorded privacy review outcome against the sampled notifications.
Pass when the review is recorded and no disclosure exception is open.

generic.Defined scope/population: One claim record per policy and date of loss for the notified death.
generic.In-scope period: From notification receipt until the claim number is returned to intake correspondence.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cause of death, date of death, reporter, reported date and claim type populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open claims on the policy and date of death equal one with no duplicates.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Claim creation event stamped with creating user and system timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate search hits logged with the decision to reuse or create a record.
generic.Test population: All claim records created in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero duplicate open claims on the same policy and date of death.
generic.Exception handling path: Policy link failures route to the Claims Analyst before the claim is progressed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim linked to a policy id with product code and face amount pulled from the policy master.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim header and the workflow tool queue entry.

steps.title: Search ClaimCenter for an existing claim before creating
sop: Search by policy number and date of loss across open and closed claims.
Review any hit to decide whether to reuse the existing record.
Record the duplicate search result before creating anything.
Done when the duplicate search is run and its outcome recorded.
verify: Re-run the duplicate search after creation.
Pass when exactly one open claim exists for that policy and date of death.

steps.title: Create the claim with the notification data
sop: Create the claim record in ClaimCenter.
Populate cause of death, date of death, reporter and reported date from the notification.
Leave no mandatory intake field blank or defaulted.
Done when all notification fields are populated on the new claim.
verify: Compare the claim header fields to the notification record.
Pass when every field matches the notification source values.

steps.title: Link the claim to the PolicyCenter policy record
sop: Select the matching policy from PolicyCenter and link it to the claim.
Confirm face amount, product code and issue date pull through automatically.
Investigate any field that fails to populate before progressing.
Done when the claim shows the policy id with pulled-through policy values.
verify: Compare pulled-through face amount and product code to the policy master.
Pass when the values on the claim equal the policy master values.

steps.title: Set the claim type so the correct requirements template loads
sop: Select death, accidental death, annuity death or waiver as the claim type.
Confirm the requirements template that loads matches the selected type.
Correct the type before requirements are issued if the template is wrong.
Done when the claim type is set and the matching template is loaded.
verify: Read the loaded requirements template name against the claim type.
Pass when the template corresponds to the selected claim type.

steps.title: Place the claim on the workflow tool intake queue
sop: Save the claim and confirm it appears on the intake queue in the workflow tool.
Confirm the claim carries the correct priority band for its face amount.
Escalate any claim that fails to appear on the queue.
Done when the claim is visible on the intake queue with a priority band.
verify: Open the intake queue and locate the new claim number.
Pass when the claim is present with a priority band assigned.

steps.title: Return the claim number to the intake correspondence
sop: Capture the system-generated claim number from the saved record.
Insert it into the intake correspondence and the notification record.
Confirm the reporter will see the claim number on the acknowledgment.
Done when the claim number appears on the intake correspondence.
verify: Read the intake correspondence draft for the claim number.
Pass when the claim number on the correspondence equals the created claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: Death notifications received from beneficiaries, agents or estate representatives on any channel.
generic.In-scope period: From the moment the notification is received until the claim is opened and logged.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reporter name, relationship, phone, address, channel and received date and time captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notifications received on each channel equal claims opened plus logged non-claims.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Source call note, letter or portal submission imaged to the claim document folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sanctions screening hits at first notice logged and held for compliance disposition.
generic.Test population: All death notifications logged in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of notifications carry reporter details and a first-notice sanctions screening result.
generic.Exception handling path: Notifications lacking a date of death are progressed with a diary and no claim decision made.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification record shows reporter name, relationship and received date and time.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter notification record and the claim document repository folder.

steps.title: Capture reporter details on the ClaimCenter notification record
sop: Record the reporter's full name and relationship to the insured.
Record the reporter's phone number and postal address.
Confirm spelling of the name back to the caller where taken verbally.
Done when all reporter identity and contact fields are populated.
verify: Read the notification record for the four reporter fields.
Pass when name, relationship, phone and address are all present.

steps.title: Record the notification channel and received timestamp
sop: Select the channel of call, agent submission, portal or mail.
Record the date and time the notification was received, not the date keyed.
For mail, use the postmark or received-stamp date.
Done when channel and received date and time are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded received time to the source channel evidence.
Pass when the recorded timestamp matches the source evidence.

steps.title: Capture the reported death particulars
sop: Ask for and record the date of death as reported.
Record the place of death and the manner of death as reported.
Mark each value as reported rather than verified until the certificate arrives.
Done when the three death particulars are recorded as reported values.
verify: Read the three particulars against the source notification.
Pass when all three are present and marked as reported not verified.

steps.title: Image the source notification to the claim folder
sop: Attach the call note, letter or portal submission to the claim document folder.
Index it under the notification document type.
Confirm the image is legible and shows the receipt date.
Done when the source notification is imaged and indexed on the claim.
verify: Open the indexed document and read its receipt date.
Pass when the source document is legible and dated on the claim.

steps.title: Run the first-notice sanctions screen
sop: Submit the reporter and any named beneficiaries for sanctions screening.
Record the screening result and timestamp against the claim.
Route any potential hit to compliance and hold the claim from payment set-up.
Done when a screening result is recorded for every named party.
verify: List parties named at first notice and read their screening results.
Pass when each named party has a recorded screening result and timestamp.

steps.title: Open the corresponding death claim and link the CRM contact
sop: Open the death claim from the notification record so the data carries across.
Link the reporter to the CRM contact record for future correspondence.
Confirm the claim number is written back to the notification record.
Done when the claim is open and linked to the notification and CRM contact.
verify: Open the notification record and follow the claim link.
Pass when the notification resolves to an open claim carrying the reporter details.

generic.Defined scope/population: All diary dates required at intake on a newly opened death claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the acknowledgment date forward across the requirement, status-letter and interest clocks.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each diary carries a due date, a named owner and a reason code.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open requirements on the claim equal diary entries tracking them.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Diary creation events stamped in ClaimCenter with creating user and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing state rule data logged and escalated before the status-letter diary is set.
generic.Test population: All open death claims in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No open claim exists without at least one future-dated diary entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Diaries that cannot be owned individually are assigned to the claims queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Requirement, status-letter, contestability and interest diaries present where applicable.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter diary panel and the handler work list in the workflow tool.

steps.title: Set the outstanding-requirements diary in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the acknowledgment send date from the correspondence log.
Set the first follow-up diary at 10 business days from that date.
Tag the diary with the outstanding-requirements reason code.
Done when the 10-business-day requirements diary exists on the claim.
verify: Recompute 10 business days from the acknowledgment date.
Pass when the diary due date equals the recomputed date.

steps.title: Set the state status-letter diary
sop: Read the claimant's state of residence from the claimant record.
Look up the statutory status-letter interval for that state.
Set a recurring diary at that interval while requirements remain open.
Done when the status-letter diary is set at the state interval.
verify: Compare the diary interval to the state rule table entry.
Pass when the interval matches the rule for the claimant's state.

steps.title: Set the contestability-window diary where applicable
sop: Compare date of death to the policy issue and last reinstatement dates.
Where death falls within two years of either, set the contestability diary.
Record the window computation on the diary note.
Done when the contestability diary exists on every in-window claim.
verify: List claims flagged contestable and read their diary entries.
Pass when every contestable claim carries a contestability diary.

steps.title: Set the statutory-interest accrual diary
sop: Identify the statutory payment date for the governing state.
Set a diary to recalculate interest if payment slips past that date.
Note the interest rate source on the diary entry.
Done when the interest recalculation diary is on the claim.
verify: Read the diary due date against the statutory payment date.
Pass when the diary fires on or before the statutory payment date.

steps.title: Assign a named owner to every diary
sop: Open each diary created and set its owner to the handler or the claims queue.
Avoid leaving any diary with a blank owner field.
Confirm queue-owned diaries survive handler reassignment.
Done when every diary on the claim carries an owner.
verify: List diaries on the claim and read their owner fields.
Pass when no diary has a blank owner.

steps.title: Confirm the diaries surface on the handler work list
sop: Open the handler work list in the workflow tool.
Confirm each created diary appears with its due date.
Escalate any diary that fails to surface on the work list.
Done when all intake diaries are visible on the handler work list.
verify: Count diaries on the claim against entries on the work list.
Pass when the counts agree and each carries a future due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every death certificate submitted in support of an open death claim.
generic.In-scope period: From certificate receipt until the authenticity determination is recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Registrar seal, file number, registration date and registrar signature present and legible.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Certificates received equal authenticity determinations recorded on claims.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certificate image retained in OpenText with received date and imaging user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Altered or suspicious certificates logged with an SIU referral number.
generic.Test population: All death certificates received on claims in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No benefit is released on an uncertified or funeral-home copy.
generic.Exception handling path: Doubtful certificates hold the claim and route to SIU with the original retained.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Certified copy on file showing issuing jurisdiction and registrar seal.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository proof-of-death folder with the OpenText image reference.

steps.title: Confirm the document is a certified copy
sop: Open the certificate image in the claim document repository.
Confirm a raised or embossed registrar seal and the issuing jurisdiction are visible.
Reject plain photocopies and funeral-home worksheets.
Done when the certified-copy status is recorded on the claim.
verify: Re-open the image and look for the seal and jurisdiction.
Pass when both the seal and issuing jurisdiction are visible on the image.

steps.title: Check registrar identifiers on the certificate
sop: Read the file number, registration date and registrar signature.
Confirm each is present and legible on the image.
Record the file number on the claim for later verification calls.
Done when the three registrar identifiers are recorded on the claim.
verify: Compare the recorded file number to the certificate image.
Pass when all three identifiers are recorded and match the image.

steps.title: Confirm the issuing office matches the place of death
sop: Read the place of death recorded on the certificate.
Confirm the issuing vital records office covers that jurisdiction.
Query any certificate issued by an unrelated jurisdiction.
Done when the issuing office and place of death are reconciled.
verify: Read the reconciliation note against the certificate image.
Pass when the issuing office matches the jurisdiction of the place of death.

steps.title: Apply the foreign-death evidence rule
sop: Determine whether the death occurred outside the United States.
Where it did, require a consular report of death abroad or an apostilled certificate.
Require a certified translation where the document is not in English.
Done when foreign deaths carry consular or apostilled evidence with translation.
verify: List foreign-death claims in the period and read their evidence type.
Pass when each carries consular or apostilled evidence plus translation.

steps.title: Refer altered certificates to SIU
sop: Inspect the image for alteration, correction fluid or mismatched fonts.
Where any is present, raise the SIU referral and retain the original in the file.
Apply the payment hold pending the SIU outcome.
Done when every suspect certificate has an SIU referral and a hold.
verify: List certificates marked suspect and read their referral numbers.
Pass when each suspect certificate has a referral and an active payment hold.

steps.title: Record the authenticity determination in ClaimCenter
sop: Select the outcome of authentic, queried or doubted on the claim.
Cite the seal, file number and issuing office checks in the rationale.
Mark the proof-of-death requirement satisfied only where the outcome is authentic.
Done when the authenticity determination is saved with its rationale.
verify: Read the saved determination against the checks recorded.
Pass when the outcome is supported by the recorded checks and no hold is bypassed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Primary and contingent beneficiary designations of record on the policy at date of death.
generic.In-scope period: The designation history up to date of death including all effective-dated changes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each beneficiary carries name, relationship, share percentage and effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Primary shares total 100% and contingent shares total 100% independently.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Designation of record printed to the claim file with its effective date and print date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assignments, irrevocable designations and predeceased beneficiaries logged with treatment.
generic.Test population: All death claims requiring a payee determination in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payable determination is made where shares do not total 100%.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved designation conflicts route to the competing-claimant process.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Designation of record on file with effective date and percentage splits shown.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository beneficiary folder and the ClaimCenter payee panel.

steps.title: Print the designation of record from PolicyCenter
sop: Open the beneficiary designation of record with its effective date.
Print or export it to the claim document repository.
Compare it to the imaged designation forms on file.
Done when the designation of record is on the claim with its effective date.
verify: Compare the printed designation to the imaged source forms.
Pass when the printed record agrees with the latest imaged form.

steps.title: Confirm share percentages and survivorship
sop: Sum the primary share percentages and then the contingent percentages.
Confirm each set totals 100% exactly.
Check whether any named beneficiary predeceased the insured.
Done when both totals are confirmed and survivorship is checked for each payee.
verify: Recompute both percentage totals from the designation record.
Pass when both totals equal 100% and each payee has a survivorship marker.

steps.title: Check for assignments and irrevocable designations
sop: Search the policy record for absolute and collateral assignments.
Identify any irrevocable designation restricting change or payment.
Record each override and the party it benefits on the claim payee panel.
Done when every override affecting payment is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded overrides to the PolicyCenter assignment register.
Pass when every registered assignment appears on the claim payee panel.

steps.title: Apply the contract default where no valid beneficiary survives
sop: Where no named beneficiary survives, read the contract default provision.
Apply the default payee, commonly the insured's estate.
Record the provision text or clause reference relied upon.
Done when the default payee and its clause reference are recorded.
verify: Read the recorded clause reference against the contract wording.
Pass when the applied default matches the cited contract clause.

steps.title: Screen for divorce-revocation statutes
sop: Identify whether a former spouse is named as a beneficiary.
Check the insured's state for a divorce-revocation statute.
Request the divorce decree where the statute may apply and record the outcome.
Done when the divorce-revocation screen outcome is recorded.
verify: List claims naming a former spouse and read their screen outcomes.
Pass when each carries a recorded statute screen and supporting decree where needed.

steps.title: Confirm the payable designation on the ClaimCenter payee panel
sop: Load the confirmed payees and shares onto the claim payee panel.
Block the payable determination while any share total is not 100%.
Record the verification conclusion and date on the claim.
Done when the payee panel reflects the verified designation.
verify: Query claims with a payable determination and non-100% share totals.
Pass when that query returns no claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims proposed for the adjudication queue with a complete requirements list.
generic.In-scope period: From the last requirement satisfied until the good-order date is stamped.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Good-order date, requirement statuses, identity and sanctions results all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Requirements marked satisfied equal total requirements raised on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Good-order stamp recorded in ClaimCenter with the setting user and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any waived requirement logged with the approving examiner and the waiver reason.
generic.Test population: All claims advanced to adjudication in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero claims in the adjudication queue with an outstanding mandatory requirement.
generic.Exception handling path: Deficient requirements return the claim to requirements gathering with a diary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Good-order date stamped before the adjudication status change.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter requirements panel and the workflow tool adjudication queue.

steps.title: Confirm every requirement is satisfied not merely received
sop: Open the claim requirements panel in ClaimCenter.
Read the status of every requirement on the list.
Treat received-deficient as outstanding and do not advance.
Done when every requirement shows received-satisfied.
verify: Count requirements by status on the claim.
Pass when the satisfied count equals the total and no deficient item remains.

steps.title: Verify the core documents are present and legible
sop: Open the certified death certificate, claimant statement and each payee W-9.
Confirm each is legible and matches the claim and policy numbers.
Reject and re-request any illegible image.
Done when all core documents are confirmed present and legible.
verify: Open each core document from the claim document repository.
Pass when all three document types open legibly for every payee.

steps.title: Confirm identity and sanctions clearance for every payee
sop: Read the identity verification result recorded for each payee.
Read the sanctions screening result and its timestamp for each payee.
Hold the claim where either is unresolved for any payee.
Done when every payee shows cleared identity and sanctions results.
verify: List payees on the claim and read both result fields.
Pass when no payee carries a refer or unresolved result.

steps.title: Stamp the good-order date on the claim
sop: Set the good-order date to the date the last requirement became satisfied.
Confirm the statutory interest and payment clocks now run from that date.
Do not backdate or forward-date the stamp.
Done when the good-order date is stamped on the claim.
verify: Compare the good-order date to the last requirement satisfied date.
Pass when the two dates agree.

steps.title: Move the claim to the adjudication queue
sop: Change the claim status to adjudication in ClaimCenter.
Confirm the status change occurs after the good-order stamp.
Record the advancing user and time on the claim.
Done when the claim shows adjudication status with a preceding good-order stamp.
verify: Read the status change timestamp against the good-order timestamp.
Pass when the good-order stamp precedes the status change.

steps.title: Confirm the claim appears on the adjudicator work list
sop: Open the adjudication queue in the workflow tool.
Locate the claim and confirm its priority and owner.
Escalate any advanced claim that fails to appear on the queue.
Done when the claim is visible on the adjudicator work list.
verify: Compare claims advanced today to entries on the adjudication queue.
Pass when every advanced claim appears on the queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every claimant asserting entitlement to a share of the death proceeds.
generic.In-scope period: From claimant identification until identity verification is cleared or referred.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Photo ID reference, verification score, relationship and authority evidence per claimant.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claimants on the claim equal identity verification results recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: ID image and LexisNexis Risk result stored with the verification run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every refer result logged and escalated to the Life Claims Examiner before any waiver.
generic.Test population: All claimants recorded on death claims in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payment is set up for a claimant in refer status.
generic.Exception handling path: Refer results hold payment and require examiner review with supplementary evidence.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Identity verification result and ID image recorded against each claimant.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claimant record with the CRM contact and stored ID image.

steps.title: Collect government-issued photo ID per claimant
sop: Request a government-issued photo ID from each claimant.
Compare the name and date of birth to the designation of record.
Image the ID to the claimant record in ClaimCenter.
Done when a legible ID image is on file for every claimant.
verify: Open the ID image for each claimant on the claim.
Pass when every claimant has a legible ID image on file.

steps.title: Run the claimant through LexisNexis Risk verification
sop: Submit the claimant identity data to the verification service.
Record the returned pass or refer score on the claimant record.
Save the raw service response with its run date.
Done when a verification score is recorded for every claimant.
verify: List claimants and read their recorded verification scores.
Pass when no claimant is missing a score and run date.

steps.title: Verify claimed relationship against the designation
sop: Compare the claimant's asserted relationship to the designation of record.
Request supporting proof where the relationship differs from the designation.
Record the relationship conclusion on the claimant record.
Done when each claimant carries a verified relationship conclusion.
verify: Read each relationship conclusion against the designation of record.
Pass when every claimant's relationship is consistent or supported by proof.

steps.title: Obtain authority documents for trust and estate claimants
sop: For a trust claimant, obtain the trust certification naming the authorised signer.
For an estate claimant, obtain letters testamentary or letters of administration.
Confirm the signer on the claim forms is the person named in the authority document.
Done when every non-individual claimant has an authority document on file.
verify: List non-individual claimants and open their authority documents.
Pass when each names the signer who executed the claim forms.

steps.title: Escalate refer results to the examiner
sop: Identify claimants returning a refer verification result.
Escalate each to the Life Claims Examiner with the ID and service response.
Apply the payment hold until the examiner records a disposition.
Done when every refer result is escalated and held.
verify: Query claimants in refer status with active payment set-up.
Pass when that query returns no claimants.

steps.title: Record the authentication outcome on the claimant record
sop: Record the final authentication outcome of verified or referred.
Link the ID image, service response and any authority document to the outcome.
Update the CRM contact so future correspondence uses the verified details.
Done when each claimant carries a linked authentication outcome.
verify: Open each claimant outcome and follow its evidence links.
Pass when every outcome resolves to the supporting evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every jurisdictional claim form executed by a claimant on the death claim.
generic.In-scope period: From form receipt until the corresponding requirement is marked satisfied.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signature, date, fraud warning text and notarisation present where required.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Executed forms imaged equal requirements marked satisfied for form execution.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each executed form imaged with received date and form version identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unsigned or undated forms logged as deficient with a re-request issued.
generic.Test population: All jurisdictional forms received on claims in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No requirement is marked satisfied against an unsigned or undated form.
generic.Exception handling path: Deficient forms return to the claimant with the specific defect named.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signature, date and required notarisation visible on the imaged form.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository forms folder with the ClaimCenter requirement link.

steps.title: Confirm the claimant signed and dated the statement
sop: Open the imaged claimant statement in the document repository.
Confirm the signature is that of the claimant and not the agent or funeral director.
Confirm a signature date is present and legible.
Done when the signature and date are confirmed for each claimant statement.
verify: Compare the signature name to the claimant of record.
Pass when the signer is the claimant and the form carries a legible date.

steps.title: Check state fraud warning language on each form
sop: Read the claimant's state of residence from the claimant record.
Confirm the executed form carries that state's fraud warning wording.
Re-issue the correct state form where the warning is absent or wrong.
Done when every executed form carries the correct state fraud warning.
verify: Compare the warning text on the form to the state form template.
Pass when the warning text matches the template for that state.

steps.title: Confirm notarisation and witness signatures
sop: Determine whether the jurisdiction or settlement option requires notarisation.
Confirm the notary seal, commission expiry and witness signatures where required.
Record the notarisation check outcome against the form.
Done when every form requiring notarisation shows a valid seal.
verify: Open forms flagged as requiring notarisation and read the seal details.
Pass when each shows a valid unexpired notary commission.

steps.title: Validate small-estate affidavits against state thresholds
sop: Identify payments proposed on a small-estate or affidavit basis.
Confirm the benefit is within the state statutory dollar threshold.
Confirm the statutory waiting period has elapsed before the affidavit is relied on.
Done when each affidavit is confirmed within threshold and waiting period.
verify: Compare the benefit amount and elapsed days to the state rule table.
Pass when every affidavit payment sits inside the threshold and waiting period.

steps.title: Image each executed form to the claim repository
sop: Image the executed form at full page including signature and seal areas.
Index it under the executed-forms document type on the claim.
Record the received date on the index entry.
Done when every executed form is imaged and indexed with a received date.
verify: Open each indexed form and confirm the signature area is captured.
Pass when every form image shows the full signature and seal area.

steps.title: Mark the requirement satisfied in ClaimCenter
sop: Link the imaged form to its requirement on the claim.
Mark the requirement satisfied only where signature, date and notarisation checks passed.
Mark it received-deficient with the defect text where any check failed.
Done when every form requirement carries a satisfied or deficient status.
verify: Query requirements marked satisfied whose linked form lacks a signature or date.
Pass when that query returns no requirements.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every in-force policy or contract identified on the insured requiring a claim requirements list.
generic.In-scope period: From coverage identification until the consolidated requirements list is published.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Product type, state of issue, claimant residence state and payee type recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: In-force coverages equal requirements lists generated for the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Requirements list stored on the claim with the template version and generation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverages where no template exists logged and escalated before issuing the kit.
generic.Test population: All claims with in-force coverage identified in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim with in-force coverage lacks a requirements list.
generic.Exception handling path: Unusual payee types route to the examiner for a manually extended requirements list.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Requirements list shows the product type and governing jurisdiction used to derive it.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter requirements panel and the published claimant kit record.

steps.title: Load the requirements template by product type
sop: Read the product type from the linked PolicyCenter contract.
Load the matching template for term, whole life, universal life, annuity or group certificate.
Record the template name and version on the claim.
Done when the product-specific template is loaded and recorded.
verify: Compare the loaded template to the product code on the policy master.
Pass when the template corresponds to the contract product code.

steps.title: Apply the governing jurisdiction rules
sop: Read the state of issue and the claimant's state of residence.
Apply the jurisdiction rule set that governs the claim.
Record which state was treated as governing and why.
Done when the governing jurisdiction is recorded on the requirements list.
verify: Read the recorded governing state against the two source states.
Pass when the selection follows the documented jurisdiction rule.

steps.title: Add contestability requirements where in window
sop: Check whether death falls within the contestable window.
Where it does, add the application copy and medical authorisation requirements.
Note the contestable driver against each added requirement.
Done when contestable claims carry the additional requirements.
verify: List contestable claims and read their requirements lists.
Pass when each carries the application copy and medical authorisation items.

steps.title: Add estate and trust payee requirements
sop: Identify payees that are not individuals.
Add letters testamentary, EIN and trust certification requirements as applicable.
Record the payee type driving each added requirement.
Done when every non-individual payee has its entity requirements added.
verify: List non-individual payees and read their requirement sets.
Pass when each set includes the entity documents for that payee type.

steps.title: Consolidate requirements across all coverages
sop: Merge requirements from every in-force coverage into one consolidated list.
De-duplicate items that appear on more than one coverage.
Retain the coverage reference against each requirement.
Done when a single consolidated list covers every in-force contract.
verify: Compare the consolidated list to the coverage list on the claim.
Pass when every in-force coverage is represented on the list.

steps.title: Publish the list to the claim and the claimant kit
sop: Publish the consolidated list to the ClaimCenter requirements panel.
Publish the same list into the claimant kit so both match.
Record the publication date and version on the claim.
Done when the claim list and the claimant kit list are identical.
verify: Compare the kit requirements list to the claim requirements panel.
Pass when the two lists contain the same items.

generic.Defined scope/population: All outstanding claim requirements on open death claims awaiting claimant submission.
generic.In-scope period: From the requirement due date until it is satisfied or the claim is referred to outreach.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each follow-up records date, channel, person spoken to and the requirement chased.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Overdue requirements equal logged follow-up attempts for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Status letters imaged with issue date and template version against the claim.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims aged past 90 days with no response referred to lost-beneficiary outreach.
generic.Test population: All claims with an outstanding requirement during the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Status letters issued for every statutory interval the claim remained pending.
generic.Exception handling path: Two unanswered attempts on the primary channel escalate to a second channel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No outstanding requirement ages past its diary date without a logged attempt.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter contact log and the correspondence record in the CRM.

steps.title: Work the outstanding-requirements diary in the workflow tool
sop: Open the diary work list and select requirements due today.
Read the claimant's elected contact channel from the claimant record.
Contact the claimant on that channel about the specific requirement.
Done when every due diary item has a contact attempt recorded.
verify: Compare due diary items to contact attempts logged for the day.
Pass when every due item has a logged attempt.

steps.title: Issue the state-required status letter
sop: Determine the statutory status-letter interval for the claimant's state.
Generate the status letter from the approved template on each interval.
Image the issued letter to the claim with its issue date.
Done when a status letter is issued for the interval just elapsed.
verify: List intervals elapsed while the claim was pending and read issued letters.
Pass when a letter exists for every elapsed interval.

steps.title: Escalate to a second contact method after two attempts
sop: Count unanswered attempts on the primary channel for each requirement.
Where two attempts are unanswered, switch to a second channel.
Record the escalation and the new channel used.
Done when every twice-unanswered requirement shows a second-channel attempt.
verify: List requirements with two unanswered primary attempts.
Pass when each shows a subsequent attempt on a different channel.

steps.title: Record each follow-up in the ClaimCenter contact log
sop: Create a contact entry with date, channel and person spoken to.
Name the specific requirement chased on the entry.
Record the claimant's stated response and any promised date.
Done when each follow-up has a complete contact log entry.
verify: Read a sample of contact entries for the four required fields.
Pass when every sampled entry carries all four fields.

steps.title: Refer non-responsive claims to lost-beneficiary outreach
sop: Identify claims aged beyond 90 days with no claimant response.
Refer each to the lost-beneficiary outreach process.
Record the referral date and reason on the claim.
Done when every qualifying claim carries an outreach referral.
verify: List claims aged beyond 90 days with no response.
Pass when each carries a dated outreach referral.

steps.title: Reset the follow-up diary from the latest contact
sop: Reset the diary date from the latest contact date, not the original date.
Confirm the diary owner remains populated after the reset.
Confirm the item stays visible on the handler work list.
Done when every worked requirement carries a future diary date.
verify: List outstanding requirements and read their diary dates.
Pass when no outstanding requirement has a past-dated diary.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each named beneficiary and each share of proceeds requiring its own requirements checklist.
generic.In-scope period: From beneficiary confirmation until the per-claimant checklists are attached to the kits.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payee residency, age, capacity and entity type recorded before the checklist is built.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Checklists produced equal named beneficiaries on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each checklist stored on the claim with generation date and template version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Beneficiaries needing guardianship or trustee proof logged with the added requirement.
generic.Test population: All claims with more than one named beneficiary in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No single combined checklist is issued to multiple unrelated beneficiaries.
generic.Exception handling path: Unknown residency defers the tax form choice to the examiner before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A per-claimant checklist is stored for every named beneficiary.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claimant records with checklists in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Generate a separate checklist per beneficiary share
sop: Read the confirmed beneficiary list and share percentages from the claim.
Generate one requirements checklist per beneficiary and per share.
Attach each checklist to its own claimant record.
Done when every beneficiary share has its own checklist.
verify: Count checklists produced against named beneficiaries on the claim.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Add the correct tax form by payee residency
sop: Read each payee's residency status from the claimant record.
Add a W-9 for US persons and a W-8BEN for non-resident aliens.
Record the residency basis used for the selection.
Done when each checklist carries the correct residency tax form.
verify: Compare each selected form to the recorded residency status.
Pass when the form matches the residency on every checklist.

steps.title: Add guardianship requirements for protected beneficiaries
sop: Identify beneficiaries who are minors or under conservatorship.
Add court-appointment or custodian requirements to those checklists.
Record the state threshold that drives the requirement.
Done when every protected beneficiary checklist carries an authority requirement.
verify: List protected beneficiaries and read their checklists.
Pass when each includes a guardianship or custodian requirement.

steps.title: Add trustee certification for trust beneficiaries
sop: Identify beneficiaries recorded as a trust in PolicyCenter.
Add the trustee certification and trust excerpt requirements.
Note the trust name and date on the checklist.
Done when each trust beneficiary checklist carries trustee requirements.
verify: List trust beneficiaries and read their checklist items.
Pass when each includes trustee certification and a trust excerpt.

steps.title: Attach each checklist to the matching claimant kit
sop: Attach each checklist to that beneficiary's own kit only.
Confirm no kit contains another beneficiary's requirements.
Record the attachment against the claimant record.
Done when every kit carries only its own beneficiary's checklist.
verify: Open two kits and read their enclosed checklists.
Pass when each kit contains only the addressee's requirements.

steps.title: Store the checklists on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Index each checklist to the claim document repository under the claimant folder.
Record the generation date and template version on the index entry.
Link the checklist to the requirements panel entries it created.
Done when every checklist is indexed and linked on the claim.
verify: Open each claimant folder and locate the stored checklist.
Pass when every claimant folder holds its dated checklist.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claim kits due to every beneficiary named on the claim.
generic.In-scope period: From requirements publication until each kit is sent and logged.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claimant name, address, enclosure list, send date and channel recorded per kit.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Kits sent equal beneficiaries recorded on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Kit contents imaged with template versions and the send date logged.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable kits logged and routed to address verification before re-issue.
generic.Test population: All claim kits issued in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No kit is issued that omits the state fraud warning.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing settlement-option content stops the send until the packet is corrected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Send date and enclosure list logged against each claimant.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter correspondence log and the CRM claimant contact history.

steps.title: Assemble the kit contents in ClaimCenter
sop: Include the claimant statement and the residency-correct tax form.
Include the settlement option election form.
Include that claimant's requirements checklist.
Done when the four core kit components are assembled per claimant.
verify: Read the assembled enclosure list for each claimant.
Pass when all four core components appear on every list.

steps.title: Insert the state fraud warning and settlement disclosure
sop: Read the claimant's state of residence.
Insert that state's fraud warning and claim-settlement disclosure.
Record the disclosure template versions used.
Done when both state-mandated texts are in the kit.
verify: Compare the inserted texts to the state disclosure matrix.
Pass when both texts match the current approved versions for that state.

steps.title: Add the retained asset account disclosure where applicable
sop: Determine whether a retained asset account is the default settlement mode.
Where it is, include the account disclosure in the kit.
Record the inclusion decision and its basis on the claim.
Done when the account disclosure is included wherever the default applies.
verify: List claims with a retained asset account default in the period.
Pass when each kit for those claims includes the account disclosure.

steps.title: Address each kit to an individual beneficiary
sop: Address one kit per beneficiary using the verified address on record.
Never enclose one beneficiary's forms in another beneficiary's kit.
Confirm the addressee name matches the designation of record.
Done when every beneficiary has an individually addressed kit.
verify: Compare the addressee list to the beneficiary list on the claim.
Pass when each beneficiary has exactly one addressed kit.

steps.title: Send the kits and log the despatch
sop: Send each kit on the claimant's elected or default channel.
Log the send date, channel and enclosure list against the claimant record.
Update the CRM contact history with the send event.
Done when every kit shows a logged send date and enclosure list.
verify: Read the correspondence log entries for the claim.
Pass when every claimant carries a send date, channel and enclosure list.

steps.title: Diary the kit response and handle returns
sop: Set the response diary for each kit sent.
Log any returned undeliverable kit against the claimant record.
Route returned kits to address verification before re-issue.
Done when each kit has a response diary and returns are logged.
verify: List kits sent and read their diary and return status.
Pass when every kit carries a diary and any return is logged.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every inbound and outbound claimant contact and requirement status change on the claim.
generic.In-scope period: The whole period the claim remains pending requirements, logged within 24 hours of each contact.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each entry carries date, direction, channel, requirement id and outcome.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Requirement status changes equal contact or document log entries supporting them.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Log entries timestamped in ClaimCenter with the recording user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claimant hardship, language need or representative noted on the claimant record.
generic.Test population: All contacts on pending claims in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No requirement status changes without a corresponding log entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Contacts that cannot be tagged to a requirement escalate to the Claims Analyst.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every log entry carries a requirement reference and an outcome.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter contact log with the mirrored CRM interaction history.

steps.title: Record every claimant contact within 24 hours
sop: Create a log entry for each inbound and outbound claimant contact.
Record the entry within 24 hours of the contact.
Capture direction, channel and the person spoken to.
Done when each contact has an entry logged inside 24 hours.
verify: Compare contact times to entry creation times for a sample.
Pass when every sampled entry was created within 24 hours.
