steps.title: Tag each entry with the requirement being chased
sop: Select the requirement id the contact relates to.
Attach the tag to the log entry so ageing reports stay accurate.
Where more than one requirement is discussed, tag each of them.
Done when every entry carries at least one requirement tag.
verify: List log entries with no requirement tag.
Pass when that list is empty for the claim.

steps.title: Update requirement status as documents arrive
sop: Set each requirement to received, in review or satisfied as evidence arrives.
Link the arriving document to the requirement being updated.
Avoid setting satisfied before the document has been reviewed.
Done when requirement statuses reflect the documents actually received.
verify: Compare requirement statuses to linked documents on the claim.
Pass when every satisfied requirement has a linked reviewed document.

steps.title: Note claimant hardship, language and representative details
sop: Record any stated hardship, language need or authorised representative.
Store the note on the claimant record rather than only in the contact text.
Apply the resulting handling preference to future contacts.
Done when claimant handling needs are recorded on the claimant record.
verify: Open claimant records for contacts noting a special need.
Pass when the need is recorded on the claimant record.

steps.title: Reset the follow-up diary from the latest contact
sop: Reset the diary date from the latest contact rather than the original date.
Retain the diary owner and requirement tag on the reset entry.
Confirm the reset item still appears on the work list.
Done when the diary reflects the most recent contact date.
verify: Compare diary dates to the latest contact date per requirement.
Pass when each diary is derived from the latest contact.

steps.title: Reconcile the log against requirement status changes
sop: List requirement status changes for the claim in the period.
Match each change to a contact or document log entry.
Investigate and correct any change without supporting log evidence.
Done when every status change is matched to a log entry.
verify: Query status changes with no corresponding log entry.
Pass when that query returns no rows for the claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: Submissions found incomplete, illegible or inconsistent that require a further request.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the defect until the corrected document is received or diarised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document name, defect description and acceptable correction stated in the request.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Defects identified equal written requests issued to claimants.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written request imaged to the claim with issue date and template version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests for documents already on file logged as errors and withdrawn.
generic.Test population: All additional-information requests issued in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero repeat requests for a document already imaged to the claim file.
generic.Exception handling path: Contestability medical needs route through the HIPAA authorisation enclosure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written request on file naming the specific document and the specific defect.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository correspondence folder and the ClaimCenter diary.

steps.title: Identify the specific defect on the submission
sop: Open the deficient submission in the claim document repository.
Name the defect precisely such as missing signature or uncertified copy.
Record the defect against the requirement in ClaimCenter.
Done when the requirement carries a specific named defect.
verify: Read the recorded defect text against the document image.
Pass when the defect text describes an observable fault on the image.

steps.title: Search the repository before re-requesting
sop: Search the claim document repository for the document already on file.
Where a compliant copy exists, close the defect instead of requesting.
Record the search outcome before issuing any request.
Done when the pre-request repository search is recorded.
verify: List requests issued and check each for a preceding search record.
Pass when no request was issued for a document already on file.

steps.title: Issue the written request naming the document and defect
sop: Draft the request naming the document, the defect and the acceptable correction.
Use the approved template for the claimant's state.
Send it on the claimant's elected channel and image the sent copy.
Done when the written request is sent and imaged to the claim.
verify: Open the imaged request and read its three required elements.
Pass when document, defect and acceptable correction are all named.

steps.title: Enclose the HIPAA authorisation for contestability needs
sop: Determine whether medical records are needed for a contestable review.
Enclose the HIPAA-compliant authorisation form with the request.
Explain who must sign the authorisation as personal representative.
Done when contestable requests carry the authorisation enclosure.
verify: List contestable claims with medical requests issued.
Pass when each request enclosed the HIPAA authorisation form.

steps.title: Set the follow-up diary to the state response window
sop: Read the state response window for additional-information requests.
Set the follow-up diary consistent with that window.
Assign the diary an owner and tag it to the requirement.
Done when the request carries an owned diary at the state interval.
verify: Compare the diary interval to the state rule table.
Pass when the diary date matches the state response window.

steps.title: Log the request against the requirement in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the request date and channel against the requirement.
Keep the requirement in received-deficient status until corrected.
Link the imaged request to the requirement entry.
Done when the request is logged and linked on the requirement.
verify: Open the requirement and follow the linked request.
Pass when the requirement resolves to the imaged dated request.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every document submitted against a claim requirement awaiting good-order review.
generic.In-scope period: From document receipt until each requirement is marked satisfied or deficient.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim number, policy number, insured name, date of death and SSN consistent across documents.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents received equal review outcomes recorded on requirements.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review outcome stamped with reviewer identity and review date in ClaimCenter.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each deficiency recorded with specific text and a follow-up request raised.
generic.Test population: All submissions reviewed on death claims in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Good-order status is never set while a requirement sits in received-deficient state.
generic.Exception handling path: Cross-document inconsistencies route to the examiner before any status change.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Per-document outcome recorded as satisfied or deficient with the deficiency text.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText document images linked to the ClaimCenter requirements panel.

steps.title: Open each submitted document in OpenText
sop: Open each imaged submission at full resolution.
Confirm the image is legible, complete and not truncated.
Confirm the claim and policy numbers on the document match the claim.
Done when every submission has been opened and checked for legibility.
verify: Re-open a sample of reviewed images.
Pass when each sampled image is legible and carries the correct claim reference.

steps.title: Cross-check identity data across the documents
sop: Compare insured name, date of death and SSN across certificate, statement and tax form.
Record any inconsistency between the documents.
Hold the requirement where the values conflict.
Done when the cross-document consistency check is recorded.
verify: Read the consistency check note against the three documents.
Pass when all three agree or an inconsistency is recorded and held.

steps.title: Confirm signing authority matches the beneficiary of record
sop: Compare the signing claimant to the beneficiary of record for that share.
Where they differ, locate the documented authority to sign.
Record the authority conclusion on the requirement.
Done when each signed document has a recorded signing authority conclusion.
verify: Read the signing authority conclusions against the designation of record.
Pass when every signer is the beneficiary or holds documented authority.

steps.title: Mark each requirement satisfied or deficient
sop: Set each reviewed requirement to received-satisfied or received-deficient.
Where deficient, write the specific deficiency text on the requirement.
Trigger the additional-information request for each deficiency.
Done when every reviewed requirement carries an outcome and any deficiency text.
verify: List requirements marked deficient and read their deficiency text.
Pass when every deficient requirement has specific text and a raised request.

steps.title: Withhold good order while any deficiency is open
sop: Check the requirements panel for any received-deficient item.
Do not set the good-order status while any such item exists.
Record the blocking requirement on the claim note.
Done when good order is set only with zero deficient requirements.
verify: Query claims in good order carrying a received-deficient requirement.
Pass when that query returns no claims.

steps.title: Record the reviewer and review date on the claim
sop: Stamp the reviewer identity and review date on each outcome.
Link the reviewed image to the requirement outcome.
Keep superseded review outcomes visible rather than overwriting them.
Done when every outcome carries reviewer identity and date.
verify: Open a sample of outcomes and read reviewer and date.
Pass when every sampled outcome carries both values.

generic.Defined scope/population: Certified death certificates supporting claims where authenticity must be independently established.
generic.In-scope period: From certificate receipt until the authenticity determination is recorded on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vital-records seal, file number, registrar signature and issuing jurisdiction all captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Certificates reviewed equal authenticity determinations recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certificate image and any issuing-office verification note stored with dates in OpenText.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Doubted certificates logged with an SIU referral and an active payment hold.
generic.Test population: All certificates reviewed for authenticity in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No proceeds are released on a certificate flagged authenticity-doubted.
generic.Exception handling path: Doubtful certificates go to the SIU Investigator and to the issuing vital-records office.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Determination recorded with an issuing-office verification note where queried.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository proof-of-death folder with the OpenText image reference.

steps.title: Verify the vital-records seal and registrar details
sop: Open the certificate image and locate the vital-records seal.
Read the file number and registrar signature of the issuing jurisdiction.
Record all three identifiers on the claim.
Done when seal, file number and registrar signature are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded identifiers to the certificate image.
Pass when all three are visible on the image and recorded correctly.

steps.title: Confirm the document is an original certified copy
sop: Assess whether the image is a certified copy or a scan of a scan.
Reject funeral-director statements offered in place of a certificate.
Record the copy-type conclusion on the claim.
Done when the copy type is recorded for the certificate.
verify: Read the recorded copy type against the image quality and seal.
Pass when the conclusion is supported by a visible original seal.

steps.title: Cross-check cause and manner against the reported cause
sop: Read the cause and manner of death from the certificate.
Compare them to the cause reported at first notice.
Record any discrepancy suggesting a substituted or amended certificate.
Done when the cause comparison is recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the comparison note against the notification record.
Pass when the note reflects the reported cause and the certificate cause.

steps.title: Apply the foreign-death evidence requirement
sop: Determine whether the death occurred abroad.
Require the Consular Report of Death or an apostilled equivalent.
Require a certified translation where the document is not in English.
Done when foreign deaths carry consular or apostilled evidence.
verify: List foreign-death claims in the period and read their evidence.
Pass when each carries consular or apostilled evidence with translation.

steps.title: Query the issuing office where authenticity is doubted
sop: Contact the issuing vital-records office to confirm the file number.
Record the officer contacted, the date and the response received.
Maintain the payment hold until the response is received.
Done when a verification note is on file for every queried certificate.
verify: List queried certificates and read their verification notes.
Pass when each queried certificate carries a dated office response note.

steps.title: Record the authenticity determination and hold status
sop: Record the outcome of authentic, queried or doubted on the claim.
Keep the payment hold active on any doubted certificate.
Link the verification note and SIU referral to the determination.
Done when the determination and hold status are saved.
verify: Query claims with proceeds released on a doubted certificate.
Pass when that query returns no claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: Interpleader claim files where the court has released the company and proceeds have been paid out.
generic.In-scope period: From the court order of discharge until the claim and legal matter are both closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Discharge order reference, registry receipt, final indemnity and expense figures recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disbursed proceeds plus awarded fees equal the deposited amount plus registry interest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Court order and registry receipt imaged to the claim with their court dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreconciled ledger differences logged and cleared before the closure is set.
generic.Test population: All interpleader claims closed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero closed interpleader claims carrying an open reserve balance.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing discharge orders keep the file open and route to Legal Counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Court order of discharge imaged before the claim status is set to closed.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim file plus the legal matter management case record.

steps.title: Confirm the court order of discharge is on file
sop: Obtain the entered order discharging the company from further liability.
Image it to the claim document repository with the court entry date.
Record the order reference on the legal matter record.
Done when the discharge order is imaged and referenced on the claim.
verify: Open the imaged order and read the discharge wording and entry date.
Pass when the order discharges the company and is dated by the court.

steps.title: Verify the registry deposit cleared
sop: Retrieve the court registry receipt for the deposited proceeds.
Confirm the funds cleared from the company account to the registry.
Attach the receipt to the claim file.
Done when the cleared registry receipt is attached to the claim.
verify: Compare the receipt amount to the disbursement posted in the ledger.
Pass when the receipt amount matches the cleared ledger entry.

steps.title: Reconcile the disbursement and fees to the ledger
sop: List the interpleader disbursement and any awarded counsel fees.
Reconcile each to the general ledger interpleader account.
Investigate and clear any variance before closing.
Done when the interpleader account reconciles with no open variance.
verify: Read the reconciliation for the interpleader ledger account.
Pass when the account balance is nil with no unexplained variance.

steps.title: Release the remaining claim reserve
sop: Read the outstanding reserve balance on the claim.
Release the remaining reserve to zero.
Record the final indemnity and expense figures on the claim.
Done when the reserve is zero and final figures are recorded.
verify: Read the reserve balance on the claim after release.
Pass when the reserve is zero and final figures are populated.

steps.title: Set the claim to closed-interpleader in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the closure reason to closed-interpleader with the closure date.
Confirm no open diaries or requirements remain on the claim.
Confirm the discharge order is attached before saving the closure.
Done when the claim shows closed-interpleader status.
verify: Read the closure date against the discharge order entry date.
Pass when the closure follows the discharge order and no diary is open.

steps.title: Close the matter in legal matter management
sop: Confirm all counsel invoices are received and approved.
Set the matter status to closed with the final cost recorded.
Link the closed matter to the closed claim record.
Done when the legal matter is closed and linked to the claim.
verify: Open the legal matter record and read its status and final cost.
Pass when the matter is closed with no unbilled counsel activity.

generic.Defined scope/population: Death claims flagged contestable requiring medical records and attending physician statements.
generic.In-scope period: The five years preceding the application date plus the period to date of death.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Provider name, record date range, condition and application question reference captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Providers identified equal record orders raised and responses tracked.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: HIPAA authorisation and each record set imaged in OpenText with received dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Providers who fail to respond logged with follow-up or subpoena decisions.
generic.Test population: All contestable investigations opened in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No medical record is ordered before a signed HIPAA authorisation is on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Suspected concealment routes to the SIU Investigator alongside the medical review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Investigation memo links each record finding to a specific application question.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository medical folder with the ClaimCenter investigation memo.

steps.title: Obtain the signed HIPAA authorisation
sop: Identify the personal representative entitled to sign the authorisation.
Issue the HIPAA-compliant authorisation and obtain the signature.
Image the signed authorisation to the claim with its signature date.
Done when a signed authorisation is on file before any record order.
verify: Compare the authorisation signature date to the first record order date.
Pass when the authorisation predates every record order on the claim.

steps.title: Build the provider list from all available sources
sop: Extract providers named on the application and the death certificate.
Add providers found in the pharmacy and prescription history.
Record each provider with speciality and the period they treated the insured.
Done when the consolidated provider list is stored on the claim.
verify: Compare the provider list to the application and certificate sources.
Pass when every source-named provider appears on the list.

steps.title: Order attending physician statements and records
sop: Order records covering the five years preceding the application date.
Order an attending physician statement from the treating physician at death.
Log each order with its date, provider and requested date range.
Done when every provider on the list has a logged record order.
verify: Compare orders logged to providers on the consolidated list.
Pass when every provider has an order covering the required period.

steps.title: Index received records against application questions
sop: Index each received record by provider, date range and condition.
Map each disclosed and undisclosed condition to the application question it answers.
Note the record page supporting each mapped condition.
Done when every condition found is mapped to an application question.
verify: Open the index and follow two mappings to their record pages.
Pass when each mapped condition resolves to a cited record page.

steps.title: Refer suspected concealment to SIU
sop: Assess whether the pattern of omissions suggests deliberate concealment.
Raise the SIU referral with the record index attached where it does.
Record the referral number on the claim.
Done when concealment concerns carry an SIU referral.
verify: List investigations flagged for concealment and read their referrals.
Pass when each carries a referral number and attached index.

steps.title: Write the contestable investigation memo
sop: Summarise findings linking each record excerpt to the application question at issue.
State what the records show and what the application answer said.
File the memo to the claim and notify the examiner.
Done when the memo is filed with question-level linkage.
verify: Read the memo for explicit application question references.
Pass when every finding in the memo cites an application question and record page.

generic.Defined scope/population: Disputed policy proceeds being deposited into the court registry under an interpleader action.
generic.In-scope period: Interest accrued from date of death to the deposit date is included in the amount.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Case number, registry instructions, deposit amount and payee clerk details captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deposit amount equals net proceeds plus statutory interest to the deposit date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Registry receipt filed to the claim with the deposit date and instrument reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sanctions or instruction anomalies logged and cleared before the instrument is issued.
generic.Test population: All interpleader deposits made in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero disputed proceeds paid directly to a claimant before the court order.
generic.Exception handling path: Registry instruction gaps route back to Legal Counsel before any funds move.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Registry receipt matching the calculated proceeds plus interest attached to the claim.
generic.Evidence location: Legal matter management case file with the ERP ledger posting reference.

steps.title: Confirm the deposit amount including statutory interest
sop: Take the net proceeds figure from the benefit calculation worksheet.
Add statutory interest accrued from date of death to the planned deposit date.
Record the deposit amount and its two components on the claim.
Done when the deposit amount is agreed with its interest component shown.
verify: Recompute interest to the deposit date from the worksheet inputs.
Pass when the recomputed total equals the recorded deposit amount.

steps.title: Obtain the court registry deposit instructions
sop: Obtain the registry deposit instructions and the assigned case number.
Confirm the exact payee style required by the clerk of court.
Record the instructions on the legal matter record.
Done when instructions and case number are recorded before issuing funds.
verify: Read the recorded instructions against the court communication.
Pass when the case number and payee style match the court source.

steps.title: Screen the court registry payee for sanctions
sop: Submit the clerk of court payee details for sanctions screening.
Record the screening result, list version and timestamp.
Hold the instrument until a clear result is returned.
Done when a clear sanctions result is retained against the payment.
verify: Read the screening record attached to the payment.
Pass when a clear result exists dated before the instrument issue.

steps.title: Issue the deposit instrument through the payment system
sop: Raise the payment payable to the clerk of court, never to a claimant.
Select company check or wire as the court instructions require.
Reference the case number on the instrument.
Done when the instrument is issued to the clerk of court with the case number.
verify: Read the payee name and reference on the issued instrument.
Pass when the payee is the clerk of court and the case number is present.

steps.title: File the registry receipt to the claim
sop: Obtain the court registry receipt confirming the deposit.
Image it to the claim file and the legal matter record.
Record the deposit date from the receipt on the claim.
Done when the registry receipt is filed with its deposit date.
verify: Compare the receipt amount to the recorded deposit amount.
Pass when the two amounts agree exactly.

steps.title: Post the disbursement to the interpleader ledger account
sop: Post the disbursement to the interpleader ledger account in the ERP.
Confirm the claim reserve is adjusted for the deposited amount.
Reconcile the posting to the registry receipt.
Done when the ledger posting matches the registry receipt.
verify: Read the interpleader ledger account movement for the period.
Pass when the posted amount equals the registry receipt amount.

generic.Defined scope/population: Contestable claims where a misrepresentation has been identified and a disposition is required.
generic.In-scope period: The contestable period measured from issue or last reinstatement to date of death.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Application question reference, underwriting guideline, disposition and approver recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium refund on rescission equals premiums paid plus interest per the calculation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coverage rationale and legal sign-off stored on the claim with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any disposition without full second-level review logged and blocked from issue.
generic.Test population: All contestable coverage decisions made in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No rescission or denial issues without documented second-level and legal review.
generic.Exception handling path: Borderline materiality routes to Legal Counsel before the disposition is selected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written rationale citing the specific application questions and underwriting guideline.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter decision panel with the rationale in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Test materiality against the underwriting guidelines in force
sop: Retrieve the underwriting guidelines applicable at the policy issue date.
Assess whether each omission would have changed the decision or rate class.
Record the materiality conclusion with the guideline reference.
Done when materiality is concluded against the guidelines in force at issue.
verify: Read the conclusion against the cited guideline version.
Pass when the guideline cited is the version in force at issue.

steps.title: Confirm the death falls inside the contestable period
sop: Read the issue date and any reinstatement date from PolicyCenter.
Compute the contestable window from the later of those dates.
Confirm the date of death falls inside the window.
Done when the contestable window computation is recorded on the claim.
verify: Recompute the window from the policy dates.
Pass when the recomputed window contains the date of death.

steps.title: Select the disposition
sop: Choose to pay in full, pay an adjusted benefit or rescind and refund premium.
Base the choice on the materiality conclusion and the contract wording.
Record the disposition and the reasoning on the claim decision panel.
Done when the disposition is recorded with its reasoning.
verify: Read the disposition against the materiality conclusion.
Pass when the disposition follows logically from the recorded conclusion.

steps.title: Calculate the premium refund for a rescission
sop: For rescission, total the premiums paid on the contract.
Add interest at the required rate to the refund calculation date.
Prepare the rescission letter citing the specific application answers.
Done when the refund calculation and rescission letter are drafted.
verify: Recompute the premium total from the PolicyCenter premium history.
Pass when the refund equals premiums paid plus the computed interest.

steps.title: Obtain second-level and legal sign-off
sop: Route the proposed rescission or denial for second-level claims review.
Obtain legal sign-off on the rationale and the letter wording.
Record both approvals with approver identity and date on the claim.
Done when both approvals are recorded before the letter issues.
verify: Compare approval timestamps to the letter issue date.
Pass when both approvals precede the issue of any adverse decision.

steps.title: Record the written coverage rationale on the claim
sop: Write the rationale naming the application questions relied upon.
Cite the underwriting guideline and the medical evidence supporting materiality.
File the rationale to the claim document repository.
Done when the rationale is filed with question and guideline citations.
verify: Read the filed rationale for question numbers and guideline references.
Pass when both are explicitly cited in the filed document.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every contestable claim reaching a decision that must be documented and communicated.
generic.In-scope period: From the decision date until the claimant letter is issued and the clocks start.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outcome code, decision date, contract provision and appeal route recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Contestable decisions made equal decision memos and letters issued.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision memo, medical index and legal note attached with dates in OpenText.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Letters missing mandated notices logged and re-issued before the appeal window runs.
generic.Test population: All contestability decisions recorded in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No adverse letter omits the contract provision or the insurance department notice.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed wording routes to Legal Counsel before the letter is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Outcome code and decision memo present on the claim file.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter decision panel and the claim document repository decision folder.

steps.title: Record the contestability outcome code in ClaimCenter
sop: Select the outcome of cleared, adjusted, rescinded or denied.
Record the outcome against the contestable investigation on the claim.
Confirm the code matches the disposition reached in the coverage decision.
Done when the outcome code is saved on the claim.
verify: Compare the outcome code to the recorded coverage disposition.
Pass when the code and the disposition agree.

steps.title: Attach the decision memo and evidence index
sop: Attach the decision memo to the claim document repository.
Attach the medical evidence index and the legal review note.
Index all three under the decision document type.
Done when memo, evidence index and legal note are attached.
verify: Open the decision folder and list its contents.
Pass when all three documents are present and indexed.

steps.title: Draft the claimant decision letter
sop: State the decision plainly and name the contract provision relied upon.
Set out the appeal route and the time allowed to appeal.
Use the approved template for the claimant's state.
Done when the letter states decision, provision and appeal route.
verify: Read the draft for the three mandatory elements.
Pass when decision, contract provision and appeal route all appear.

steps.title: Include the department of insurance notice
sop: Insert the state-required notice of the right to contact the insurance department.
Confirm the department contact details are current for that state.
Record the notice version used on the claim.
Done when the department notice is included in the letter.
verify: Compare the notice text and contact details to the state template.
Pass when the notice matches the current state template.

steps.title: Issue the letter and image it to the claim
sop: Send the letter to the claimant on the recorded channel.
Image the sent letter to the claim under the decision document type.
Log the send date and channel against the claimant record.
Done when the letter is sent and imaged with a logged send date.
verify: Open the imaged letter and read its send date.
Pass when the imaged letter matches what was sent and is dated.

steps.title: Log the decision date to start the payment and appeal clocks
sop: Record the decision date on the claim.
Confirm the payment or refund clock starts from that date.
Set the appeal window diary from the letter issue date.
Done when the decision date and appeal diary are both set.
verify: Read the decision date and appeal diary against the letter issue date.
Pass when both derive from the recorded letter issue date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Disputed claims approved for interpleader where a court filing is to be made.
generic.In-scope period: From management approval of the recommendation until the court accepts the filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval reference, venue, litigation plan, budget and claimant schedule recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claimants named in the complaint equal claimants on the competing-claimant schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Accepted filing stamp and case number recorded with the court acceptance date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Filings rejected by the court logged with the corrective action and refiling date.
generic.Test population: All interpleader filings made in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No interpleader is filed without an approved litigation plan and budget.
generic.Exception handling path: Venue uncertainty returns to Legal Counsel before instructing panel counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Court-issued case number and accepted filing stamp recorded on the claim.
generic.Evidence location: Legal matter management case record linked to the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Confirm documented management approval of the recommendation
sop: Retrieve the interpleader recommendation and its approval record.
Confirm the approver held authority for the disputed amount.
Record the approval reference on the claim before instructing counsel.
Done when the approval reference is recorded on the claim.
verify: Read the approval record for approver identity and date.
Pass when the approval predates any instruction to counsel.

steps.title: Open the matter and instruct panel counsel
sop: Open the matter in legal matter management with a budget and litigation plan.
Instruct panel counsel with the scope and the desired outcome.
Record the counsel firm, fee basis and budget on the matter.
Done when the matter exists with an approved plan and budget.
verify: Open the matter record and read plan and budget fields.
Pass when both are populated and approved before filing.

steps.title: Determine the proper venue and jurisdiction
sop: Assess the claimants' residences and the contract's governing law.
Determine whether federal statutory interpleader jurisdiction is available.
Record the chosen venue and the reasoning on the matter.
Done when the venue decision and reasoning are recorded.
verify: Read the recorded venue reasoning against the claimant residences.
Pass when the chosen venue is supported by the recorded analysis.

steps.title: Provide counsel the complete claim file
sop: Assemble the policy, designation history and competing claims correspondence.
Include the calculated proceeds and interest figures.
Transmit the pack to counsel and log the transmission on the claim.
Done when counsel confirms receipt of the complete pack.
verify: Compare the pack contents list to the claim file index.
Pass when policy, designations, competing claims and proceeds are all included.

steps.title: File the complaint naming every identified claimant
sop: Confirm the complaint names every claimant on the competing-claimant schedule.
File the complaint in the chosen venue.
Record the filing date on the matter record.
Done when the complaint is filed naming all identified claimants.
verify: Compare the claimants named in the complaint to the schedule.
Pass when the two lists match exactly.

steps.title: Record the case number and acceptance on the claim
sop: Obtain the court acceptance and the issued case number.
Record both on the legal matter and on the ClaimCenter claim.
Image the accepted filing stamp to the claim file.
Done when case number and acceptance stamp are recorded on both systems.
verify: Open the claim and the matter record and compare case numbers.
Pass when both carry the same court-issued case number and stamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every party asserting an interest in the policy proceeds on a disputed claim.
generic.In-scope period: From the first competing assertion until the claimant schedule is complete and held.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Party name, contact, asserted legal basis and asserted share recorded per claimant.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Asserted shares are listed in full even where they exceed 100% of proceeds.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Supporting documents for each assertion imaged with received dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Slayer-statute or criminal-proceeding bars logged with the pending outcome.
generic.Test population: All claims with more than one asserted interest in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payment is released while a competing-claim hold is active.
generic.Exception handling path: Novel legal bases route to Legal Counsel for an opinion before disposition.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Competing-claimant schedule lists each party and their asserted legal basis.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter competing-claimant panel with documents in the claim repository.

steps.title: List every party asserting an interest
sop: Capture named beneficiaries, former spouses, estate representatives and assignees.
Capture creditors and any other party asserting a claim to proceeds.
Record each party with contact details on the competing-claimant panel.
Done when every asserting party is listed on the schedule.
verify: Compare the schedule to the claim correspondence for asserting parties.
Pass when every party who has written in appears on the schedule.

steps.title: Record the legal basis each party asserts
sop: Record whether the basis is designation, divorce decree, community property or assignment.
Attach the document the party relies on for that basis.
Note the asserted share against each party.
Done when every party carries a legal basis and asserted share.
verify: Open each party entry and follow its supporting document link.
Pass when every asserted basis resolves to a supporting document.

steps.title: Review the beneficiary change history for a disputed change
sop: Pull the designation change history from PolicyCenter.
Identify any late change that another party disputes.
Attach the change history to the competing-claimant schedule.
Done when the change history is attached and disputed changes are marked.
verify: Compare disputed changes marked to the change history extract.
Pass when every disputed change appears on the attached history.

steps.title: Check for slayer-statute bars
sop: Determine whether any claimant is implicated in the insured's death.
Check the applicable state slayer statute and any pending criminal proceeding.
Record the bar status and the proceeding reference on the claimant entry.
Done when the slayer-statute screen outcome is recorded for the claim.
verify: Read the recorded screen outcome and any proceeding reference.
Pass when the screen is recorded and any implicated claimant is flagged.

steps.title: Place the competing-claim payment hold
sop: Apply the competing-claim hold on the ClaimCenter claim.
Link the hold to the competing-claimant schedule.
Notify the handler that no payment may issue while the hold stands.
Done when the hold is active and linked to the schedule.
verify: Query payments released on claims with an active competing-claim hold.
Pass when that query returns no payments.

steps.title: Publish the competing-claimant schedule on the claim
sop: Finalise the schedule listing each party, basis, share and evidence.
Save it to the claim so counsel and management can rely on it.
Diary the schedule for update as further parties emerge.
Done when the schedule is published and diarised for review.
verify: Open the published schedule and read its four columns.
Pass when each party has a basis, an asserted share and linked evidence.

generic.Defined scope/population: Contested beneficiary designations or community property assertions requiring a legal opinion.
generic.In-scope period: From the opinion request until the written opinion is received and filed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Designation history, competing claims, governing state law and questions posed recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Questions posed equal questions answered in the returned opinion.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Opinion filed to the privileged claim section with its receipt date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unanswered questions logged and re-put to counsel before any disposition.
generic.Test population: All contested-designation claims in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No disposition decision is made before the legal opinion is received.
generic.Exception handling path: Urgent matters proceed only with a documented interim counsel position.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written opinion filed on the claim with its receipt date recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Legal matter management opinion record with the privileged claim file section.

steps.title: Prepare the opinion request in legal matter management
sop: Set out the designation history and each competing claim asserted.
State the governing state law and the contract provisions in issue.
Open the opinion request on the legal matter record.
Done when the opinion request is drafted and opened on the matter.
verify: Read the request against the competing-claimant schedule.
Pass when every asserted claim appears in the request.

steps.title: Identify the specific questions to be answered
sop: Pose the validity question on the last designation of record.
Pose the community property share question where a spouse asserts one.
Pose the divorce revocation question where a former spouse is named.
Done when each applicable question is explicitly posed.
verify: Count the questions posed against the asserted bases on the schedule.
Pass when every asserted basis has a corresponding question.

steps.title: Provide counsel the supporting documents
sop: Provide the certified designation forms and the death certificate.
Provide the divorce decree or marital property agreement where relevant.
Log the document transmission on the claim.
Done when counsel confirms receipt of the supporting documents.
verify: Compare the transmitted document list to the questions posed.
Pass when every question has the documents needed to answer it.

steps.title: Obtain the written opinion with a recommended disposition
sop: Require the opinion to state a recommended disposition.
Require it to state whether interpleader is advisable.
Confirm every posed question is addressed before accepting the opinion.
Done when the written opinion addresses all posed questions.
verify: Map each posed question to its answer in the opinion.
Pass when no posed question is left unanswered.

steps.title: File the opinion in the privileged claim section
sop: File the opinion to the privileged section of the claim file.
Confirm access is restricted to claims and legal staff.
Record the receipt date on the claim.
Done when the opinion is filed as privileged with its receipt date.
verify: Open the privileged section and check the access restriction.
Pass when the opinion is present and access is restricted.

steps.title: Block disposition until the opinion is on file
sop: Hold the claim from any disposition decision while the opinion is outstanding.
Diary the opinion for chasing if it is not received by the target date.
Release the hold only once the opinion is filed.
Done when no disposition can be taken before the opinion is filed.
verify: Query contested-designation claims with a disposition dated before the opinion receipt.
Pass when that query returns no claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: Disputed claims where reconciliation between competing claimants has failed.
generic.In-scope period: From the first reconciliation attempt until the recommendation is approved or rejected.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attempts made, claimant responses, cost comparison, venue and opinion reference recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Competing claimants contacted equal claimants on the competing-claimant schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recommendation memo stored on the claim with author, date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claimants who would not respond logged with the attempts made.
generic.Test population: All interpleader recommendations raised in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No recommendation is approved without documented attempts to obtain claimant releases.
generic.Exception handling path: Recommendations failing the cost test return for further reconciliation attempts.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Memo records reconciliation attempts and the cost versus proceeds comparison.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter recommendation memo linked to the legal matter management record.

steps.title: Document the reconciliation attempts with each claimant
sop: List each competing claimant contacted and the date of contact.
Record the position each claimant took in response.
Attach the correspondence supporting each attempt.
Done when every competing claimant has a documented attempt and response.
verify: Compare attempts documented to the competing-claimant schedule.
Pass when every claimant on the schedule has a documented attempt.

steps.title: Confirm no claimant will execute a release or disclaimer
sop: Offer a release or disclaimer route to each claimant in writing.
Record each refusal or non-response against the claimant.
Confirm no combination of releases would resolve the dispute.
Done when the release position of every claimant is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded release positions for the claim.
Pass when each claimant has an explicit release position recorded.

steps.title: Compare interpleader cost against disputed proceeds
sop: Estimate the interpleader filing cost and counsel fees.
Compare the estimate to the disputed proceeds amount.
Record the comparison and the conclusion on the memo.
Done when the cost comparison and conclusion are recorded.
verify: Recompute the ratio of estimated cost to disputed proceeds.
Pass when the recorded conclusion follows from the recomputed ratio.

steps.title: Record the recommendation with the legal opinion reference
sop: Write the recommendation memo in the ClaimCenter claim file.
Reference the legal opinion and the proposed venue.
Attach the competing-claimant schedule to the memo.
Done when the memo cites the opinion, venue and schedule.
verify: Open the memo and follow its opinion and schedule references.
Pass when both references resolve to filed documents.

steps.title: Route the recommendation for management and legal approval
sop: Route the memo to claims management and legal for approval.
Record each approver, their authority level and the decision date.
Hold counsel instruction until both approvals are recorded.
Done when both approvals are recorded on the claim.
verify: Compare the approval timestamps to the counsel instruction date.
Pass when both approvals precede any instruction to file.

steps.title: Link the recommendation to the legal matter record
sop: Open or update the matter in legal matter management.
Attach the approved recommendation memo to the matter.
Cross-reference the matter number on the claim.
Done when the memo and matter are linked in both systems.
verify: Open the matter record and locate the attached memo.
Pass when the memo is attached and the claim carries the matter number.

generic.Defined scope/population: Payees named in the court order distributing the deposited interpleader proceeds.
generic.In-scope period: From the order date until every ordered payment is issued and reconciled.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payee legal name, ordered amount, fee awards and payment method recorded per payee.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ordered distribution total equals deposited proceeds plus registry interest.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Court order and disbursement schedule attached to the claim with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sanctions hits on ordered payees logged and held pending compliance disposition.
generic.Test population: All court-ordered interpleader disbursements in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero payments issued to a payee or amount not named in the court order.
generic.Exception handling path: Order ambiguities return to Legal Counsel before any payment is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Disbursement schedule matches the court order payee names and amounts.
generic.Evidence location: Payment system disbursement records reconciled to the ERP interpleader account.

steps.title: Read the court order and build the payee schedule
sop: Read the order and list each payee with the exact ordered amount.
Record any awarded counsel fees or costs as separate lines.
Attach the order to the claim alongside the schedule.
Done when the schedule reflects every payee and amount in the order.
verify: Compare the schedule line by line to the court order.
Pass when every payee and amount matches the order exactly.

steps.title: Reconcile the ordered total to the deposited amount
sop: Total the ordered distribution across all payees and fee awards.
Compare it to the deposited proceeds plus registry interest.
Record any difference and refer it before releasing funds.
Done when the ordered total is reconciled to the deposit.
verify: Recompute the ordered total from the schedule.
Pass when the recomputed total equals the deposit plus registry interest.

steps.title: Screen each ordered payee for sanctions
sop: Submit each ordered payee for sanctions screening before release.
Retain the clear result with list version and timestamp.
Hold any payee with an unresolved hit and refer to compliance.
Done when every payee carries a clear screening result.
verify: List payees and read their screening results and timestamps.
Pass when every payee has a clear result dated before release.

steps.title: Issue payments exactly as named in the order
sop: Raise each payment in the payment system to the payee style in the order.
Set the amount to the exact ordered figure with no rounding.
Retain evidence of the negotiated instrument once cleared.
Done when every ordered payment is issued with matching payee and amount.
verify: Compare issued payments to the payee schedule.
Pass when no payment differs in payee or amount from the order.

steps.title: Record the disbursement against the ClaimCenter claim
sop: Record each payment reference and issue date on the claim.
Attach the disbursement schedule and the court order to the claim.
Update the claim status to reflect the ordered distribution completed.
Done when every payment is recorded on the claim with references.
verify: Open the claim payment panel and count recorded payments.
Pass when the count and amounts equal the ordered schedule.

steps.title: Reconcile the interpleader ledger account to zero
sop: Post all disbursements to the interpleader ledger account in the ERP.
Confirm the account balance returns to zero after the final payment.
Investigate and clear any residual balance.
Done when the interpleader ledger account balance is zero.
verify: Read the interpleader account balance after the final posting.
Pass when the balance is zero with no unexplained residual.

generic.Defined scope/population: The application, underwriting file and all medical records obtained on a contestable claim.
generic.In-scope period: Medical history predating the application plus the underwriting decision period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Provider, date range, condition and application question number indexed per record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Records received equal records indexed in the medical chronology.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Record index and materiality conclusion stored on the claim with review dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records that cannot be obtained logged with the provider follow-up outcome.
generic.Test population: All material misrepresentation reviews completed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No materiality conclusion is asserted without a supporting record citation.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous underwriting impact routes to the Life Claims Examiner and underwriting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Record index and conclusion reference specific application questions.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository medical folder with the ClaimCenter review note.

steps.title: Retrieve the application and underwriting file
sop: Retrieve the signed application and any amendments from PolicyCenter.
Retrieve the underwriting file and the policy as issued.
Image all three to the claim document repository.
Done when application, underwriting file and policy are on the claim.
verify: Open each retrieved document and confirm it relates to this policy.
Pass when all three documents are present and policy-matched.

steps.title: Index every medical record into a chronology
sop: Index each record by provider, date range and condition.
Order the entries into a single chronology across providers.
Note gaps where a provider has not yet responded.
Done when all received records are indexed into one chronology.
verify: Count records received against entries in the chronology.
Pass when the counts agree and gaps are explicitly noted.

steps.title: Identify undisclosed pre-application conditions
sop: Identify conditions, treatments and prescriptions predating the application.
Compare each to the disclosures made on the application.
Mark each as disclosed or undisclosed on the chronology.
Done when every pre-application condition carries a disclosure marker.
verify: Sample three conditions and check their markers against the application.
Pass when each marker matches what the application actually disclosed.

steps.title: Assess the underwriting impact of each omission
sop: Apply the underwriting guidelines in force at the application date.
Assess whether each omission would have changed rate class or issue decision.
Record the impact assessment per omission.
Done when every undisclosed condition has an impact assessment.
verify: Read the impact assessments against the cited guideline version.
Pass when each assessment cites the guideline in force at application.

steps.title: Write the materiality conclusion with citations
sop: State the materiality conclusion for the claim as a whole.
Cite the application question number and the record page for each finding.
File the conclusion to the claim medical folder.
Done when the conclusion is filed with question and page citations.
verify: Check each conclusion statement for a question and page citation.
Pass when no statement lacks a supporting citation.

steps.title: Refer fraud indicators to SIU
sop: Review the chronology for indicators of deliberate concealment.
Raise or update the SIU referral with the chronology attached.
Record the referral outcome on the claim.
Done when fraud indicators are referred and the outcome recorded.
verify: List reviews flagging concealment and read their referral outcomes.
Pass when each flagged review has a referral with a recorded outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every death claim screened for contestability and suicide-window exposure.
generic.In-scope period: The two years from issue or last reinstatement compared against the date of death.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Issue date, reinstatement date, date of death, cause and manner captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Death claims opened equal claims carrying computed contestable and suicide flags.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Flag computation stored on the claim with the source dates and computation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims with missing issue or reinstatement dates logged and held from routing.
generic.Test population: All death claims opened in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No death inside the contestable window is routed to the standard path.
generic.Exception handling path: Undetermined manner of death routes to investigation before the standard path.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Contestable and suicide-window flags computed and stored on every death claim.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter contestability panel with the workflow tool routing record.

steps.title: Compute the contestable window from PolicyCenter dates
sop: Read the policy issue date and the last reinstatement date.
Take the later of the two as the window start.
Compute the two-year window end from that start.
Done when the contestable window is computed and stored on the claim.
verify: Recompute the window from the two policy dates.
Pass when the stored window matches the recomputed dates.

steps.title: Set the contestable flag against the date of death
sop: Compare the date of death to the computed window.
Set the contestable flag where death falls inside the window.
Record the comparison result even where the flag is not set.
Done when every claim carries an explicit contestable flag state.
verify: List death claims and read their contestable flag states.
Pass when no claim has a blank contestable flag.

steps.title: Check the suicide-exclusion window separately
sop: Read the suicide-exclusion period from the contract wording.
Compare the date of death to that period, which may differ from contestability.
Set the suicide-window flag independently of the contestable flag.
Done when the suicide-window flag is set on its own basis.
verify: Compare the suicide window used to the contract wording.
Pass when the period applied matches the contract, not the contestable window.

steps.title: Review cause and manner on the death certificate
sop: Read the cause and manner from the certified death certificate.
Identify accident, suicide, homicide or undetermined as investigation triggers.
Record the manner and any triggered investigation on the claim.
Done when the manner is recorded and triggers are identified.
verify: Compare the recorded manner to the certificate image.
Pass when the recorded manner matches the certificate.

steps.title: Route flagged claims to the contestable queue
sop: Route contestable and suicide-window claims to the contestable queue.
Record the routing reason on the claim.
Confirm the claim leaves the standard adjudication path.
Done when every flagged claim sits in the contestable queue with a reason.
verify: Query flagged claims sitting in the standard queue.
Pass when that query returns no claims.

steps.title: Hold claims with missing policy dates
sop: Identify claims where issue or reinstatement dates are missing.
Hold those claims from routing and request the dates from policy administration.
Record the hold reason and diary the request.
Done when no claim is routed on incomplete window inputs.
verify: List claims with missing policy dates and read their status.
Pass when each is held rather than routed to a queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: Statutory interest payable on death proceeds for the governing state of the claim.
generic.In-scope period: From date of death or the statutory trigger date to the payment issue date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Governing state, rate, rate source, accrual dates and day-count basis recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Interest plus principal equals gross payable on the payment instruction.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Interest worksheet stored on the claim with preparer and calculation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rate conflicts between contract and statute logged with the rate actually used.
generic.Test population: All claims with interest calculated in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Interest is never merged into principal without a separate reportable line.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing state rate data routes to the Accountant before the calculation is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Worksheet shows rate source, accrual dates and day-count basis.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter calculation panel with the ERP interest posting reference.

steps.title: Identify the governing state and statutory rate
sop: Determine the governing state for the death proceeds.
Pull the statutory interest rate in effect at the date of death.
Record the rate and the source reference on the worksheet.
Done when the statutory rate and its source are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded rate to the state rate table for the date of death.
Pass when the rate matches the table entry for that date.

steps.title: Set the accrual start and end dates
sop: Set the accrual start at date of death or the statutory trigger date.
Set the accrual end at the payment issue date.
Record which trigger was used and why.
Done when both accrual dates and the trigger basis are recorded.
verify: Read the accrual dates against the date of death and payment date.
Pass when both dates are consistent with the recorded trigger basis.

steps.title: Compare the contract rate to the statutory rate
sop: Read any interest rate guaranteed in the contract.
Apply the contract rate where it exceeds the statutory rate.
Document which rate was used and the reason for the choice.
Done when the applied rate and the reason are documented.
verify: Compare the applied rate to both candidate rates.
Pass when the higher of the two rates was applied and documented.

steps.title: Compute interest on the prescribed basis
sop: Apply simple or compound interest as the statute prescribes.
Show the day-count basis used in the computation.
Produce the interest amount to the payment date.
Done when the interest amount is computed with a stated basis.
verify: Recompute the interest using the recorded rate, dates and basis.
Pass when the recomputed amount equals the worksheet amount.

steps.title: Record interest separately from principal
sop: Record the interest as a discrete line on the payment instruction.
Keep the principal line unchanged by the interest amount.
Flag the interest line for Form 1099-INT reporting.
Done when interest and principal appear as separate lines.
verify: Read the payment instruction lines for the claim.
Pass when interest exists as its own reportable line.

steps.title: File the interest worksheet on the claim
sop: Export the worksheet showing rate source, dates, basis and result.
File it to the claim under the calculation document type.
Record the preparer name and calculation date.
Done when the worksheet is filed with preparer and date.
verify: Open the filed worksheet and read its four required elements.
Pass when rate source, accrual dates, basis and result are all shown.

generic.Defined scope/population: The net death benefit for each in-force life policy on the deceased insured.
generic.In-scope period: All policy values taken as at the date of death, not current values.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Face amount, paid-up additions, dividends, loan principal, loan interest and arrears captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Face plus additions less deductions equals the stated net death benefit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Worksheet stored on the claim with the value extract run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Post-death policy transactions logged with their treatment in the calculation.
generic.Test population: All net benefit calculations produced in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No benefit is computed using policy values dated after the date of death.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained value movements route to the Life Claims Examiner before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Worksheet shows additions, loan offsets and premium adjustments as separate lines.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter calculation panel with the PolicyCenter value extract attached.

steps.title: Take the face amount in force at date of death
sop: Read the face amount in force at date of death from PolicyCenter.
Add paid-up additions and dividend accumulations in force at that date.
Record each element as its own worksheet line.
Done when the gross benefit base is recorded with its components.
verify: Compare the recorded base to the policy value extract.
Pass when each component matches the extract as at date of death.

steps.title: Deduct outstanding loan principal and accrued interest
sop: Read the loan principal outstanding at date of death.
Read the loan interest accrued to the same date.
Record both as separate deduction lines on the worksheet.
Done when loan principal and interest are shown as separate deductions.
verify: Compare the loan figures to the PolicyCenter loan history.
Pass when both figures match the balances as at date of death.

steps.title: Apply the grace-period unpaid premium deduction
sop: Determine whether death occurred within the premium grace period.
Where it did, deduct the unpaid premium for that period.
Record the grace determination alongside the deduction.
Done when the grace-period position is recorded and deducted if applicable.
verify: Compare the date of death to the premium due date and grace end.
Pass when the deduction is present only where death fell within grace.

steps.title: Add premium paid beyond the date of death as a refund
sop: Identify premium received for periods after the date of death.
Add it as an explicit refund line rather than netting it silently.
Label the line so the beneficiary statement can show it.
Done when post-death premium appears as a labelled refund line.
verify: Compare premium receipts after date of death to the refund line.
Pass when the refund equals the post-death premium received.

steps.title: Produce the net death benefit figure
sop: Sum the base, additions, deductions and refund lines.
Record the net death benefit as the worksheet result.
Confirm every line is labelled and none is combined.
Done when the net benefit is produced from labelled component lines.
verify: Recompute the net figure from the worksheet lines.
Pass when the recomputed total equals the recorded net benefit.

steps.title: Review the worksheet with the examiner
sop: Review each line against the policy value extract.
Challenge any value that appears dated after death.
Record the review outcome and reviewer name on the worksheet.
Done when the worksheet carries a recorded examiner review.
verify: Read the reviewer name and review date on the worksheet.
Pass when a review is recorded and no post-death value remains.

generic.Defined scope/population: The net amount payable to each beneficiary after interest, splits and withholding.
generic.In-scope period: Amounts fixed as at the payment issue date with interest accrued to that date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gross payable, share percentage, withholding type and net amount per payee.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sum of payee net amounts plus withholding equals gross payable with zero variance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Per-payee schedule stored on the claim with preparation date and preparer.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Payees without a valid TIN logged with backup withholding applied.
generic.Test population: All claims reaching a net payable confirmation in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payee lacking a valid TIN is set up without backup withholding.
generic.Exception handling path: Variance on the payee schedule blocks payment and routes to the Accountant.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Per-payee net schedule reconciles to gross payable with zero variance.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter payee schedule with the ERP withholding liability posting.

steps.title: Add statutory interest to the net death benefit
sop: Take the net death benefit from the benefit worksheet.
Add the calculated statutory interest to obtain gross payable.
Record gross payable with both components shown.
Done when gross payable is recorded with benefit and interest lines.
verify: Recompute gross payable from the two source figures.
Pass when the recomputed value equals the recorded gross payable.

steps.title: Split gross payable by beneficiary share
sop: Apply each beneficiary's share percentage to gross payable.
Record the share amount against each payee.
Confirm the shares total gross payable exactly.
Done when every payee carries a share amount summing to gross payable.
verify: Sum the payee share amounts.
Pass when the sum equals gross payable with no rounding residual.

steps.title: Apply backup withholding where no valid TIN exists
sop: Check each payee for a valid W-9 with TIN on file.
Apply backup withholding at the statutory rate where none exists.
Record the withholding basis against the payee.
Done when every TIN-deficient payee carries backup withholding.
verify: List payees without a valid TIN and read their withholding.
Pass when each shows backup withholding at the statutory rate.

steps.title: Apply federal and state withholding on taxable components
sop: Identify the interest component and any taxable gain component.
Apply federal withholding to those components only.
Apply state withholding using the payee residence state rules.
Done when withholding is applied to each taxable component.
verify: Recompute withholding on the taxable components per payee.
Pass when the recomputed amounts equal the recorded withholding.

steps.title: Reconcile net amounts plus withholding to gross payable
sop: Sum all payee net amounts and all withholding amounts.
Compare the total to gross payable.
Investigate and clear any variance before confirming.
Done when the reconciliation shows zero variance.
verify: Read the reconciliation total against gross payable.
Pass when the variance is zero.

steps.title: Confirm the payee schedule on the claim
sop: Save the confirmed per-payee schedule to the claim.
Record the confirming examiner and the confirmation date.
Lock the schedule against change without re-confirmation.
Done when the schedule is confirmed and locked on the claim.
verify: Open the schedule and read its confirmation stamp.
Pass when the schedule is locked with a named confirmer and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Accidental death and double-indemnity riders in force on the insured at date of death.
generic.In-scope period: From the accidental injury date to death within the rider's stated time limit.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rider status, premium-paid status, certified cause, manner and injury date recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Riders in force equal rider determinations recorded on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certified certificate and any coroner report imaged with received dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each rider exclusion tested is logged with a pass or fail result.
generic.Test population: All claims with an accidental death rider in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No accidental benefit is paid without the certified cause of death on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Undetermined manner of death holds the rider decision pending further evidence.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Determination cites the certified cause and each exclusion tested.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository rider folder with the ClaimCenter determination note.

steps.title: Confirm the rider was in force and premium-paid
sop: Read the rider schedule in PolicyCenter as at the date of death.
Confirm the rider was in force and not in grace or lapse.
Record the rider status and the premium position on the claim.
Done when rider status and premium position are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded status to the PolicyCenter rider schedule.
Pass when the rider was in force and premium-paid at date of death.

steps.title: Read the certified cause and manner of death
sop: Read the cause and manner from the certified death certificate.
Obtain the autopsy or coroner report where one exists.
Record the injury date and the death date from the evidence.
Done when cause, manner and injury date are recorded from certified evidence.
verify: Compare the recorded cause to the certificate image.
Pass when the recorded values match the certified documents.

steps.title: Test each rider exclusion
sop: Test self-inflicted injury, intoxication, aviation, war and hazardous activity.
Record a pass or fail result for each exclusion tested.
Cite the evidence relied on for each result.
Done when every listed exclusion carries a tested result.
verify: Read the exclusion test log for the claim.
Pass when all five exclusion categories show a tested result.

steps.title: Apply the rider time limit between injury and death
sop: Read the rider's stated number of days between injury and death.
Compute the elapsed days from the recorded injury date.
Record whether the time limit is satisfied.
Done when the time-limit test result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the elapsed days from the injury and death dates.
Pass when the recorded result matches the recomputed elapsed days.

steps.title: Compute the rider benefit amount
sop: Read the rider benefit basis and multiplier from the contract.
Compute the payable rider amount on the accepted basis.
Record the amount as a separate line from the base death benefit.
Done when the rider amount is computed as its own line.
verify: Recompute the rider amount from the contract multiplier.
Pass when the recomputed amount equals the recorded rider line.

steps.title: Record the accept or decline determination
sop: Record the accept or decline determination on the claim.
Cite the certified cause, the exclusions tested and the time-limit result.
Route declines to the adverse decision letter process.
Done when the determination is recorded with its cited evidence.
verify: Query rider benefits paid with no certified cause on file.
Pass when that query returns no claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: The completed benefit calculation worksheet for each claim reaching payment.
generic.In-scope period: From calculation completion until the worksheet is indexed on the claim file.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every input value, its source field, preparer, reviewer and calculation date shown.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Worksheet result equals the payable amount on the payment instruction.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Worksheet indexed in OpenText with version and superseded copies retained.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Superseded worksheets retained with the reason for the supersession.
generic.Test population: All claims reaching payment in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payment is released with no calculation worksheet on the claim file.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing provision references return the worksheet to the preparer before filing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Worksheet indexed with preparer, reviewer and provision reference.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository calculation folder with the OpenText index entry.

steps.title: Export the completed calculation worksheet
sop: Export the worksheet showing every input value used.
Show the source field or system for each input.
Confirm no input is shown without a traceable source.
Done when the exported worksheet shows inputs with sources.
verify: Sample three inputs and trace them to their source fields.
Pass when each sampled input resolves to a named source.

steps.title: Cite the contract provision and actuarial basis
sop: Cite the contract provision governing the benefit calculation.
Cite the actuarial formula or interest table where one was used.
Record the citations on the worksheet header.
Done when the worksheet carries provision and basis citations.
verify: Read the citations against the contract wording.
Pass when the cited provision matches the benefit computed.

steps.title: Record preparer, reviewer and calculation date
sop: Record the preparer name on the worksheet.
Record the reviewer name once the review is complete.
Record the calculation date and the review date.
Done when preparer, reviewer and both dates are recorded.
verify: Read the four fields on the worksheet header.
Pass when all four are populated and the reviewer differs from the preparer.

steps.title: Index the worksheet to the claim document folder
sop: Index the worksheet under the calculation document type in OpenText.
Link the index entry to the ClaimCenter calculation panel.
Confirm the document opens from the claim.
Done when the worksheet is indexed and opens from the claim.
verify: Open the calculation panel and launch the worksheet.
Pass when the worksheet opens from the claim under the correct type.

steps.title: Supersede rather than delete earlier versions
sop: Mark any earlier worksheet as superseded rather than deleting it.
Record the reason the earlier version was replaced.
Confirm the calculation history remains readable on the claim.
Done when superseded versions are retained with reasons.
verify: List worksheet versions on the claim.
Pass when every earlier version is present and marked superseded.
