steps.title: Block payment release without a filed worksheet
sop: Confirm the worksheet is filed before payment release is requested.
Where no worksheet exists, hold the payment instruction.
Record the hold reason on the claim.
Done when no payment is released without a filed worksheet.
verify: Query payments released on claims with no calculation worksheet.
Pass when that query returns no payments.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims where gross payable exceeds the handling unit's delegated settlement authority.
generic.In-scope period: From payable confirmation until the approval is recorded and payment is unblocked.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approver identity, authority level, amount approved and timestamp recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Amount approved is at or above the gross payable on the payment instruction.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval event stamped in ClaimCenter with the approver and decision time.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approvals below the payable logged and escalated to the next authority level.
generic.Test population: All claims exceeding delegated authority in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payment instruction is released above the recorded approved amount.
generic.Exception handling path: Absent approvers route to the next level in the approval matrix.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recorded approval names the approver and an approved amount covering the payable.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter approval panel with the workflow tool routing history.

steps.title: Compare gross payable to the delegated authority limit
sop: Read gross payable including interest from the payee schedule.
Read the handler's delegated settlement authority limit.
Record whether the limit is exceeded on the claim.
Done when the authority comparison is recorded.
verify: Recompare the two figures on the claim.
Pass when the recorded comparison matches the current payable.

steps.title: Route the claim to the next authority level
sop: Identify the next authority level in the approval matrix for the amount.
Route the claim in the workflow tool to that approver.
Record the routing time and target approver on the claim.
Done when the claim is routed to an approver with sufficient authority.
verify: Read the target approver's limit against the payable.
Pass when the target approver's limit covers the full payable.

steps.title: Present the supporting pack to the approver
sop: Attach the calculation worksheet and the payee schedule.
Attach the coverage decision and any contestability findings.
Confirm the approver can open every attachment.
Done when the approval pack is complete and accessible.
verify: Open the approval pack from the approver view.
Pass when worksheet, coverage decision and findings are all present.

steps.title: Capture the approval decision on the claim
sop: Capture the approver identity and their authority level.
Capture the amount approved and the decision timestamp.
Record any conditions attached to the approval.
Done when all four approval attributes are recorded.
verify: Read the approval record for the four attributes.
Pass when all four are populated on the claim.

steps.title: Block release until the approval covers the payable
sop: Hold the payment instruction while the payable exceeds the approved amount.
Re-route for a further approval where the payable increases.
Record the block and its release on the claim.
Done when release is only possible within the approved amount.
verify: Query payment instructions released above the recorded approval.
Pass when that query returns no instructions.

steps.title: Record the approval trail for audit
sop: Confirm the approval history is visible on the claim.
Confirm any re-approval after an amount change is also recorded.
Retain the routing history from the workflow tool.
Done when the full approval trail is retained on the claim.
verify: Read the approval history against the payable change history.
Pass when every payable change above the limit has its own approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Payment instructions for each beneficiary share on a claim ready for disbursement.
generic.In-scope period: From payable confirmation until the instruction is routed for release authorisation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payee legal name, address, bank details, claim, policy, share and withholding populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Instruction totals equal the confirmed per-payee net schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Instruction creation stamped with creating user and time in the payment system.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unverified bank details logged and held until verification is completed.
generic.Test population: All payment instructions created in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No instruction is created and released by the same user.
generic.Exception handling path: Ledger mapping failures route to the Claims Analyst before routing for release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Payee, claim, share, withholding and interest all present as discrete fields.
generic.Evidence location: Payment system instruction record linked to the ClaimCenter payment panel.

steps.title: Build the instruction with verified payee details
sop: Enter the payee legal name and address from the verified claimant record.
Enter the verified bank details for EFT elections only.
Reject any unverified bank detail entry.
Done when the instruction carries verified payee and destination details.
verify: Compare the instruction payee details to the verified claimant record.
Pass when name, address and bank details match the verified record.

steps.title: Attach the instruction to claim, policy and share
sop: Link the instruction to the claim and the underlying policy.
Link it to the specific beneficiary share being paid.
Confirm the ledger posting path resolves from those links.
Done when the instruction carries claim, policy and share links.
verify: Follow the instruction links back to the claim and share.
Pass when all three links resolve to the correct records.

steps.title: Set the payment type per the settlement election
sop: Read the validated settlement election for that beneficiary.
Set lump sum check, EFT, retained asset account or annuity set-up accordingly.
Record the election reference on the instruction.
Done when the payment type matches the validated election.
verify: Compare the instruction payment type to the signed election.
Pass when the type matches the election on file.

steps.title: Include withholding and interest as discrete lines
sop: Enter federal and state withholding amounts as their own fields.
Enter the interest component as a separate line from principal.
Confirm downstream tax reporting can read these fields.
Done when withholding and interest exist as discrete instruction fields.
verify: Read the instruction fields for withholding and interest.
Pass when both exist separately from the principal amount.

steps.title: Reconcile the instruction to the payee schedule
sop: Compare each instruction amount to the confirmed payee schedule.
Investigate and clear any difference before routing.
Record the reconciliation on the claim.
Done when the instructions reconcile to the payee schedule.
verify: Sum the instruction amounts and compare to the schedule total.
Pass when the totals agree with zero variance.

steps.title: Route for release authorisation by a second person
sop: Route the instruction for release to a user other than the creator.
Confirm the system blocks self-release.
Record the routing time and target authoriser.
Done when the instruction awaits release by a second person.
verify: Compare the creating user to the releasing user on the instruction.
Pass when the two users differ on every released instruction.

generic.Defined scope/population: The benefit calculation compared line by line to the policy master values.
generic.In-scope period: Policy values taken as at date of death with post-death transactions identified.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Face amount, loan balance, dividend values and premium status compared on both sides.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every worksheet line reconciles to a policy master value with nil variance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed reconciliation stored on the claim with the extract run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each variance traced to a transaction and logged with the correction made.
generic.Test population: All benefit calculations produced in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payment setup starts while an unexplained variance is open.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained variances route to the Life Claims Examiner and policy administration.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Nil-variance reconciliation signed off before payment setup.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter reconciliation note with the ERP and PolicyCenter extracts attached.

steps.title: Pull the policy master values as at date of death
sop: Extract face amount, loan balance, dividend values and premium status.
Set the extract as-at date to the date of death.
Attach the extract with its run date to the claim.
Done when the as-at extract is attached to the claim.
verify: Read the as-at date on the attached extract.
Pass when the extract as-at date equals the date of death.

steps.title: Compare each extract value to the worksheet line
sop: Match each extract value to its corresponding worksheet line.
Record the variance for each pair, including zeros.
Flag any worksheet line with no matching extract value.
Done when every worksheet line carries a recorded variance.
verify: Count worksheet lines against variance entries.
Pass when every line has a recorded variance value.

steps.title: Trace variances to post-death transactions
sop: For each non-zero variance, search the policy transaction history.
Identify any transaction posted after the date of death.
Record the transaction reference against the variance.
Done when every variance is traced to a transaction or marked untraced.
verify: Follow each variance to its cited transaction.
Pass when every non-zero variance resolves to a dated transaction.

steps.title: Correct the worksheet or the policy record
sop: Decide which side is wrong for each traced variance.
Correct the worksheet or raise the policy correction accordingly.
Document which side was wrong and why.
Done when both sides agree and the reason is documented.
verify: Re-run the comparison after the corrections.
Pass when no variance remains between worksheet and policy master.

steps.title: Confirm the ledger posting basis with the accountant
sop: Confirm the corrected figures post correctly to the ERP claim accounts.
Confirm reserve movements reflect the corrected benefit.
Record the ledger confirmation on the reconciliation.
Done when the ledger basis is confirmed against the corrected figures.
verify: Compare the ERP posting amount to the corrected net benefit.
Pass when the posted amount equals the corrected benefit.

steps.title: Sign off the reconciliation as nil variance
sop: Record the nil-variance conclusion on the reconciliation.
Record the signer name and sign-off date.
Release the claim to payment setup only after sign-off.
Done when the nil-variance sign-off is recorded on the claim.
verify: Query claims in payment setup with an open variance.
Pass when that query returns no claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: All policy values and adjustments needed as inputs to the death benefit calculation.
generic.In-scope period: Values captured as at the date of death, not as at the extract date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loan principal, loan interest, arrears, dividends, additions and rider values captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Captured values equal the PolicyCenter as-at extract values.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: System value extract attached to the claim with its run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Values unavailable as at date of death logged with the substitute basis used.
generic.Test population: All claims requiring a benefit calculation in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No calculation uses loan or dividend values dated after the date of death.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing rider values route to the Claims Processor for policy administration retrieval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Value extract as at date of death attached with a run date.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository calculation folder with the PolicyCenter extract.

steps.title: Capture loan principal and accrued interest
sop: Read the outstanding policy loan principal as at the date of death.
Read the loan interest accrued to that same date.
Record both values with the as-at date on the input sheet.
Done when loan principal and interest are captured as at date of death.
verify: Compare the captured values to the PolicyCenter loan screen as-at view.
Pass when both values match the as-at date of death balances.

steps.title: Capture premium arrears and grace status
sop: Read premium arrears outstanding at the date of death.
Read the grace-period status and any premium paid beyond death.
Record all three values on the input sheet.
Done when arrears, grace status and post-death premium are captured.
verify: Compare the captured premium data to the billing history.
Pass when arrears and post-death premium match the billing record.

steps.title: Capture dividend and paid-up addition values
sop: Read dividend accumulations and dividend on deposit balances.
Read paid-up additions in force at the date of death.
Record each as a separate input line.
Done when dividend and addition values are captured separately.
verify: Compare the captured values to the PolicyCenter dividend screen.
Pass when each captured value matches the as-at date of death balance.

steps.title: Capture rider values in force
sop: Read the in-force status of accidental death, child term and spouse term riders.
Read the waiver-of-premium status on the contract.
Record each rider with its benefit basis on the input sheet.
Done when every in-force rider is captured with its basis.
verify: Compare the captured rider list to the PolicyCenter rider schedule.
Pass when every in-force rider appears with its basis.

steps.title: Attach the system value extract to the claim
sop: Export the system value extract with its run date.
Attach it to the claim under the calculation document type.
Confirm the as-at date on the extract is the date of death.
Done when the extract is attached with an as-at date of death.
verify: Read the as-at and run dates on the attached extract.
Pass when the as-at date equals the date of death.

steps.title: Confirm no post-death values entered the input set
sop: Review each captured value for a post-death effective date.
Replace any post-death value with the as-at date of death value.
Record the review outcome on the input sheet.
Done when the input set contains only as-at date of death values.
verify: Check the effective dates on the captured values.
Pass when no input carries an effective date after the date of death.

generic.Defined scope/population: The accelerated payout and residual values for a contract with an acceleration rider.
generic.In-scope period: Values computed as at the acceleration election and payment dates.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Acceleration percentage, dollar cap, discount, fee and loan offset captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Accelerated amount plus residual benefit equals the pre-acceleration death benefit basis.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acceleration worksheet stored on the claim with preparer and computation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Amounts exceeding the rider cap logged and reduced before the illustration issues.
generic.Test population: All acceleration calculations produced in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No accelerated amount exceeds the rider percentage or dollar cap.
generic.Exception handling path: Cap breaches route to the Life Claims Examiner before any disclosure is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Worksheet shows gross accelerable amount, discount, fees, loan offset and residual.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter acceleration panel with the PolicyCenter value extract attached.

steps.title: Apply the rider percentage and dollar cap
sop: Read the acceleration percentage and dollar cap from the rider wording.
Apply both to the eligible death benefit to get the maximum accelerable amount.
Record the lower of the two limits as the cap applied.
Done when the maximum accelerable amount is computed and recorded.
verify: Recompute the cap from the rider percentage and the eligible benefit.
Pass when the recorded maximum does not exceed either limit.

steps.title: Apply the actuarial discount and administrative fee
sop: Apply the actuarial discount for early payment per the rider basis.
Apply the administrative fee where the rider permits one.
Show discount and fee as separate worksheet lines.
Done when discount and fee appear as separate lines.
verify: Recompute the discount using the rider basis and the payment date.
Pass when the recomputed discount equals the worksheet line.

steps.title: Deduct the pro-rata policy loan offset
sop: Read the outstanding policy loan balance from PolicyCenter.
Compute the share attributable to the accelerated portion.
Record the pro-rata loan offset as its own line.
Done when the loan offset is computed and recorded.
verify: Recompute the offset from the loan balance and the acceleration ratio.
Pass when the recomputed offset equals the recorded line.

steps.title: Compute the residual benefit and cash value
sop: Compute the residual death benefit after acceleration.
Compute the residual cash value and the adjusted future premium.
Record all three residual figures on the worksheet.
Done when the three residual figures are computed.
verify: Add the accelerated amount to the residual death benefit.
Pass when the sum equals the pre-acceleration benefit basis.

steps.title: Produce the pre and post acceleration illustration
sop: Build the illustration comparing values before and after acceleration.
Include death benefit, cash value and premium on both sides.
Prepare it for delivery with the acceleration disclosure.
Done when the comparison illustration is produced.
verify: Compare the illustration figures to the worksheet lines.
Pass when the illustration matches the worksheet on all values.

steps.title: File the acceleration worksheet on the claim
sop: Review the worksheet against the rider wording and the cap.
File the worksheet and illustration to the claim.
Record the reviewer name and review date.
Done when the reviewed worksheet is filed on the claim.
verify: Query accelerations where the amount exceeds the rider cap.
Pass when that query returns no claims.

generic.Defined scope/population: The policyowner's signed election to accelerate part of the death benefit.
generic.In-scope period: From disclosure delivery until the signed election is imaged and accepted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signature, signature date, elected amount and consent evidence captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Elected amount is within the amount quoted in the delivered illustration.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed election imaged with its signature date and receipt date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing irrevocable-beneficiary or assignee consent logged and chased.
generic.Test population: All acceleration elections received in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No acceleration proceeds without required irrevocable-beneficiary or assignee consent.
generic.Exception handling path: Elections signed before the disclosure date are rejected and re-obtained.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Election signature date falls after the disclosure delivery date.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository election folder with the ClaimCenter requirement link.

steps.title: Confirm the signer is the policyowner of record
sop: Read the policyowner of record from PolicyCenter.
Compare the election signature to that owner.
Reject elections signed by a party without ownership or authority.
Done when the signer is confirmed as the policyowner or authorised agent.
verify: Compare the signer name to the PolicyCenter owner record.
Pass when the signer is the owner or a documented authorised signer.

steps.title: Check the signature date against disclosure delivery
sop: Read the disclosure delivery date logged on the claim.
Read the election signature date from the form.
Reject any election signed before the disclosure was delivered.
Done when the signature date is confirmed to follow the disclosure.
verify: Compare the two dates on the claim.
Pass when the signature date is after the disclosure delivery date.

steps.title: Confirm the elected amount is within the illustration
sop: Read the elected acceleration amount on the form.
Compare it to the maximum quoted in the delivered illustration.
Return elections exceeding the quoted amount for correction.
Done when the elected amount is confirmed within the illustration.
verify: Compare the elected amount to the illustration maximum.
Pass when the elected amount does not exceed the quoted maximum.

steps.title: Obtain irrevocable-beneficiary and assignee consent
sop: Identify any irrevocable beneficiary or assignee on the contract.
Obtain their written consent where the contract requires it.
Image the consents and link them to the election.
Done when required consents are on file and linked.
verify: List irrevocable interests on the contract and read their consents.
Pass when every required consent is on file.

steps.title: Confirm the owner acknowledged the consequences
sop: Confirm the form acknowledges the reduced residual death benefit.
Confirm it acknowledges the cash value and public benefit effects.
Record the acknowledgement check on the claim.
Done when the acknowledgement check is recorded.
verify: Read the acknowledgement wording on the signed election.
Pass when the form shows the owner acknowledged all three effects.

steps.title: Image the election and satisfy the requirement
sop: Image the signed election to the claim document repository.
Link the image to the election requirement in ClaimCenter.
Mark the requirement satisfied once all checks have passed.
Done when the election is imaged and the requirement is satisfied.
verify: Open the requirement and follow the linked image.
Pass when the requirement resolves to a signed dated election.

generic.Defined scope/population: Physician certifications of terminal or chronic illness supporting an acceleration claim.
generic.In-scope period: The rider recency window applying to the certification date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Physician signature, date, licence number and qualifying condition captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Certifications received equal eligibility determinations recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certification and supporting records imaged in OpenText with received dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conclusory certifications logged with the clinical records ordered to support them.
generic.Test population: All acceleration medical certifications reviewed in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No eligibility is approved on a certification that ignores the rider definition.
generic.Exception handling path: Insufficient clinical support routes to further records before determination.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Certification is dated within the recency window and states the qualifying condition.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository medical folder with the ClaimCenter determination note.

steps.title: Confirm the certification is properly executed
sop: Confirm the physician statement is signed and dated.
Confirm the physician licence number is stated and legible.
Confirm the date falls within the rider recency window.
Done when signature, licence and recency are all confirmed.
verify: Compare the certification date to the rider recency window.
Pass when the certification is signed, licensed and within the window.

steps.title: Test the terminal-illness definition
sop: Read the rider's life-expectancy threshold, commonly 12 or 24 months.
Confirm the certification states a life expectancy within that threshold.
Record the tested threshold and the certified expectancy.
Done when the terminal-illness test result is recorded.
verify: Compare the certified expectancy to the rider threshold.
Pass when the certified expectancy falls within the rider threshold.

steps.title: Test the chronic-illness definition
sop: For chronic illness, count the activities of daily living the insured cannot perform.
Compare the count to the rider's required number.
Alternatively confirm severe cognitive impairment is certified.
Done when the chronic-illness test result is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded count against the rider requirement.
Pass when the certification meets the activity or cognitive standard.

steps.title: Order supporting clinical records where needed
sop: Identify certifications that are conclusory and lack diagnostic support.
Order the supporting clinical records from the treating provider.
Log each order and diary the response.
Done when supporting records are ordered for each conclusory certification.
verify: List conclusory certifications and read their record orders.
Pass when each has a logged record order or received records.

steps.title: Record the eligibility determination with the clause cited

sop: Total the package value across all states.
Reconcile it to the ERP unclaimed property liability account.
Document any variance and its cause.
Done when the package reconciles to the liability account.
verify: Compare the package total to the liability balance.
Pass when the two agree or the variance is documented.

steps.title: Finalise and retain the remittance package
sop: Finalise the per-state packages ready for filing.
Retain the package files and the reconciliation.
Record the preparation date and preparer.
Done when the packages are finalised and retained.
verify: Open a finalised state package and read its item detail.
Pass when every item shows owner, property type and dormancy date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Dormant benefits and accounts whose dormancy period has fully elapsed.
generic.In-scope period: Dormancy measured to the report cut-off date under the owner's state rules.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Dormancy elapsed date, outreach completeness, balance and referral date recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Balances transferred equal the referred benefit values.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Outreach and dormancy evidence pack retained against each referred item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items with incomplete outreach logged and returned to the outreach process.
generic.Test population: All benefits referred to escheatment in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No referred benefit remains available for draft or withdrawal after referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Late owner contact reverses the referral and unfreezes the account.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral shows dormancy elapsed, outreach complete and balance transferred.
generic.Evidence location: ERP unclaimed property liability account with the ClaimCenter referral record.

steps.title: Confirm the state dormancy period has fully elapsed
sop: Read the dormancy period for the owner's state.
Confirm it has fully elapsed as at the report cut-off date.
Record the elapsed computation against the item.
Done when dormancy elapse is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Recompute the dormancy end date from the last owner activity.
Pass when the end date precedes the report cut-off date.

steps.title: Confirm outreach and search evidence is complete
sop: Read the documented outreach attempts for the item.
Confirm the Death Master File and locator searches were completed.
Confirm no owner contact resulted from any attempt.
Done when outreach and search completeness are confirmed.
verify: Count attempts and searches against the required set.
Pass when the required outreach and searches are all evidenced.

steps.title: Freeze the account or benefit
sop: Apply the freeze so no further drafts can be presented.
Block interest elections and address changes on the item.
Record the freeze date on the account.
Done when the item is frozen against further activity.
verify: Attempt a draft or address change on a frozen item.
Pass when the system rejects the transaction.

steps.title: Transfer the balance to the liability account
sop: Transfer the item balance to the unclaimed property liability account.
Record the transfer reference and date in the ERP.
Reconcile the transfer to the item balance.
Done when the balance is transferred and reconciled.
verify: Compare the transferred amount to the item balance.
Pass when the amounts agree exactly.

steps.title: Record the escheat referral date
sop: Record the escheat referral date on the ClaimCenter record.
Link the referral to the remittance working file entry.
Note the state to which the item will be reported.
Done when the referral date and state are recorded.
verify: Read the referral record for date and target state.
Pass when both are recorded on every referred item.

steps.title: Retain the dormancy evidence pack
sop: Retain the outreach history and dormancy computation with the item.
Apply the statutory examination retention period.
Confirm the pack is retrievable for examination.
Done when the evidence pack is retained and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the evidence pack for a referred item.
Pass when outreach history and dormancy computation both open.

generic.Defined scope/population: Prepared unclaimed property packages due for filing and remittance to each state.
generic.In-scope period: Each state's statutory reporting deadline for the current cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, filing channel, report total, remittance method and confirmation number.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Remittance total equals the reported detail total for each state.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: State confirmation number and filing date retained per state.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: State rejections and queries logged and tracked to resolution.
generic.Test population: All states reported in the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No reported item remains in the liability account after remittance.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected filings return to the Claims Analyst for correction and refiling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filing confirmation and remittance evidence retained for every state reported.
generic.Evidence location: Regulatory filing tracker entries reconciled to the ERP liability account.

steps.title: File each state report by its statutory deadline
sop: File each state report through the channel that state requires.
File on or before that state's statutory deadline.
Record the filing date in the regulatory filing tracker.
Done when every state report is filed within its deadline.
verify: Compare each filing date to the state deadline.
Pass when no filing is later than its deadline.

steps.title: Remit funds by the required method
sop: Remit funds by the method each state requires.
Confirm the remittance total equals the reported detail total.
Record the remittance reference per state.
Done when funds are remitted and totals agree.
verify: Compare the remittance total to the reported detail total.
Pass when the two agree for every state.

steps.title: Retain confirmation numbers and property identifiers
sop: Retain the state confirmation number and the filing date.
Retain any property identifiers the state assigns.
Link them to the state package in the tracker.
Done when confirmations and identifiers are retained per state.
verify: Open the tracker entry for each state and read its confirmation.
Pass when every state shows a confirmation number and filing date.

steps.title: Clear remitted items from the liability account
sop: Clear the remitted items from the ERP liability account.
Clear them in the same period as the remittance.
Reconcile the cleared amount to the remittance total.
Done when the remitted items are cleared in period.
verify: Query reported items still carried in the liability account.
Pass when that query returns no items.

steps.title: Log and work state rejections and queries
sop: Log every state rejection or query in the filing tracker.
Assign an owner and a target resolution date.
Track each to resolution before the next reporting cycle.
Done when every rejection and query is logged and owned.
verify: List open rejections and read their owners and target dates.
Pass when each has an owner and a target date.

steps.title: Reconcile the cycle and report completion
sop: Reconcile filings, remittances and liability clearances for the cycle.
Report completion and any open exceptions to claims management.
Retain the cycle reconciliation for examination.
Done when the cycle reconciliation is completed and retained.
verify: Read the cycle reconciliation against the state confirmations.
Pass when every state reported has a matching confirmation and clearance.

generic.Defined scope/population: Retained asset account settlement obligations reportable to regulators this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period defined by the settlement agreement schedule.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Population, balances, interest credited, dormancy and outreach statistics captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every reported figure reconciles to its source system extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reconciliation and submission confirmation retained with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Figures that will not reconcile logged and explained before submission.
generic.Test population: All scheduled reporting periods in the year.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No scheduled reporting period lacks a submission confirmation on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled figures hold the submission pending Accountant review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Submission carries reconciliation to source extracts and recorded internal approval.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform submission record with the regulatory filing tracker confirmation.

steps.title: Extract the account population and balances
sop: Extract the account population and balances for the period.
Extract interest credited and dormancy statistics.
Record the extract run date and parameters.
Done when the population extract is produced for the period.
verify: Re-run the extract and compare totals.
Pass when the re-run totals equal the reported totals.

steps.title: Compile the outreach and payment statistics
sop: Compile outreach attempt statistics for the period.
Compile located-beneficiary payment statistics required by the agreement.
Record the source of each statistic.
Done when the required statistics are compiled with sources.
verify: Trace two statistics back to their source reports.
Pass when each traced statistic matches its source.

steps.title: Reconcile every reported figure to source
sop: Reconcile each reported figure to the source system extract.
Document any difference and its explanation.
Retain the reconciliation with the submission pack.
Done when every figure is reconciled and retained.
verify: Read the reconciliation for unexplained differences.
Pass when no figure carries an unexplained difference.

steps.title: Obtain the internal sign-off
sop: Route the submission pack for the required internal approval.
Record the approver identity and approval date.
Hold the submission until the approval is recorded.
Done when the internal approval is recorded on the pack.
verify: Compare the approval date to the submission date.
Pass when the approval precedes the submission.

steps.title: Submit through the required channel by the due date
sop: Submit the report through the required regulator channel.
Submit on or before the scheduled date.
Record the submission date and channel in the tracker.
Done when the report is submitted within the schedule.
verify: Compare the submission date to the scheduled date.
Pass when the submission is on or before the scheduled date.

steps.title: File the submission confirmation
sop: Retain the submission confirmation with its receipt date.
Link it to the GRC obligation record for the period.
Close the period obligation once the confirmation is filed.
Done when the confirmation is filed and the obligation closed.
verify: Query scheduled periods with no submission confirmation on file.
Pass when that query returns no periods.

generic.Defined scope/population: The in-force and dormant benefit population swept against death and locator services.
generic.In-scope period: The scheduled sweep cycle covering the current population extract.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Name, SSN, date of birth and last known address submitted per record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Records submitted equal records returned and dispositioned.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Input file, output file and match criteria retained with the sweep date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every hit carries a recorded disposition with its validating evidence.
generic.Test population: All sweeps run in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No near-match is closed as no-match without documented second-source validation.
generic.Exception handling path: Exact matches route to claim opening and near matches to a review queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sweep record shows input population, match criteria and per-hit disposition.
generic.Evidence location: LexisNexis Risk sweep files retained with the ClaimCenter disposition records.

steps.title: Extract the benefit population for the sweep
sop: Extract in-force and dormant benefit records for the sweep.
Include name, SSN, date of birth and last known address.
Record the extract count and run date.
Done when the sweep input file is produced with its count.
verify: Compare the input file count to the source population count.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Submit the extract to the search services
sop: Submit the extract to the Death Master File service.
Submit it to the lost-beneficiary search service on the sweep cycle.
Capture the submission references and run dates.
Done when both submissions are made and referenced.
verify: Read the submission references and run dates.
Pass when both services show a submission for the cycle.

steps.title: Apply the documented fuzzy-match criteria
sop: Apply the documented fuzzy-match criteria to the returned results.
Route exact matches and near matches into separate review queues.
Record the criteria version applied.
Done when results are routed by the documented criteria.
verify: Read the criteria version against the documented standard.
Pass when the criteria applied match the documented version.

steps.title: Validate potential matches against a second source
sop: Validate each potential match against an independent second source.
Record the second source used and its result.
Do not open a claim on a single unvalidated match.
Done when every potential match carries second-source validation.
verify: List near matches closed as no-match and read their validation.
Pass when each carries documented second-source validation.

steps.title: Open claims for validated matches
sop: Open a claim in ClaimCenter for each validated match.
Link the claim to the swept benefit record.
Record the sweep reference on the claim.
Done when every validated match has an open linked claim.
verify: Compare validated matches to claims opened.
Pass when every validated match has a corresponding claim.

steps.title: Retain the sweep files and dispositions
sop: Retain the input file, output file and match criteria.
Retain the disposition of every hit for examination.
Record the retention date on the sweep record.
Done when the full sweep evidence set is retained.
verify: Open the sweep record and list its retained artefacts.
Pass when input, output, criteria and dispositions are all retained.

generic.Defined scope/population: Drafts, withdrawals, interest crediting and statements on open retained asset accounts.
generic.In-scope period: Each crediting and statement cycle while the account remains open.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Draft amount, available balance, credited rate, cycle dates and statement fields.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Opening balance plus interest less drafts equals the closing balance each cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Transaction history and statements retained with cycle dates per account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined or partially honoured drafts logged with the reason and remedy.
generic.Test population: All open accounts serviced in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No draft for the full account balance is declined or partially honoured.
generic.Exception handling path: Rate shortfalls against statute route to the Claims Analyst for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Interest credited each cycle at or above the disclosed and statutory rate.
generic.Evidence location: Payment system account transaction history reconciled to the ERP liability.

steps.title: Process presented drafts against the balance
sop: Process each presented draft against the available balance.
Confirm no minimum-balance rule blocks a full withdrawal.
Record the draft outcome on the account.
Done when every presented draft is processed and recorded.
verify: List drafts for the full balance and read their outcomes.
Pass when none was declined or partially honoured.

steps.title: Credit interest at the disclosed rate
sop: Credit interest on the required crediting cycle.
Apply the rate stated in the delivered disclosure.
Record the rate and cycle dates on the transaction.
Done when interest is credited at the disclosed rate for the cycle.
verify: Compare the credited rate to the disclosed rate.
Pass when the credited rate matches the disclosure.

steps.title: Apply the higher statutory minimum rate where prescribed
sop: Read the state statutory minimum crediting rate where one applies.
Apply the higher of that and the disclosed rate.
Record the rate comparison on the account.
Done when the higher rate is applied and documented.
verify: Compare the applied rate to both candidate rates.
Pass when the higher rate was applied every cycle.

steps.title: Produce and mail the periodic statement
sop: Produce the statement showing opening balance, drafts and interest credited.
Show the closing balance for the cycle.
Mail it to the verified address and log the despatch.
Done when the cycle statement is produced and despatched.
verify: Recompute the closing balance from the statement lines.
Pass when the recomputed balance equals the stated closing balance.

steps.title: Track cumulative interest for tax reporting
sop: Track cumulative interest credited per account for the year.
Flag accounts meeting the 1099-INT reporting threshold.
Record the cumulative figure on the account.
Done when cumulative interest is tracked per account.
verify: Sum the cycle interest postings for one account.
Pass when the sum equals the recorded cumulative interest.

steps.title: Reconcile account activity to the ledger
sop: Reconcile drafts and interest postings to the ERP liability account.
Investigate any variance in the cycle.
Record the reconciliation outcome.
Done when the cycle activity reconciles to the ledger.
verify: Compare the account movement to the ledger movement.
Pass when the two agree with no unexplained variance.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every retained asset account settlement obligation tracked in the requirement register.
generic.In-scope period: The current compliance cycle covering disclosure, crediting, dormancy and outreach.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Obligation, mapped control, owner, current status and last test date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Obligations in the register equal obligations with a current status recorded.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sample test evidence retained with test dates against each obligation.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every exception carries a root cause, remediation owner and target date.
generic.Test population: A sample of accounts tested each period against each obligation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No open compliance exception exists without a remediation owner and target date.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed samples raise an exception routed to the control owner for remediation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Register shows current status, sample evidence and open exceptions per obligation.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform register with the BI reporting evidence extracts.

steps.title: Maintain the requirement register in the GRC platform
sop: Map each settlement obligation to a control and an owner.
Confirm every obligation in the agreement appears in the register.
Record the register version and review date.
Done when every obligation is mapped to a control and an owner.
verify: Compare register entries to the settlement agreement obligations.
Pass when every obligation is represented with a control and owner.

steps.title: Update the compliance status each cycle
sop: Update status for disclosure delivery and interest crediting.
Update status for dormancy monitoring and outreach.
Record the cycle date on each status update.
Done when all four areas carry a current status.
verify: Read the status dates against the current cycle.
Pass when every obligation shows a status dated in the cycle.

steps.title: Test a sample of accounts against each obligation
sop: Select the sample of accounts for the period.
Test each sampled account against every obligation.
Record a pass or fail with the supporting evidence.
Done when every obligation has sample test results.
verify: Open the test results and follow their evidence links.
Pass when every result resolves to retained evidence.

steps.title: Log exceptions with root cause and owner
sop: Log each failed test as an exception.
Record the root cause, remediation owner and target date.
Track the exception until it is closed.
Done when every exception carries cause, owner and target date.
verify: List open exceptions and read their three fields.
Pass when no open exception lacks an owner or target date.

steps.title: Reconcile the register to the source data
sop: Reconcile register statuses to the source system extracts.
Correct any status not supported by the source data.
Retain the reconciliation with the cycle record.
Done when the register reconciles to the source extracts.
verify: Trace two register statuses to their source extracts.
Pass when each status is supported by the source data.

steps.title: Report the compliance position to claims management
sop: Report the current compliance position on the agreed cadence.
Include the open exceptions and their target dates.
Record the report date and the recipients.
Done when the compliance position is reported and recorded.
verify: Read the issued report against the register.
Pass when the report reflects every obligation status and open exception.
